jobs.title: Senior Executive Chef / Corporate Chef
jobs.description:
**Corporate Chef | Senior Executive Chef, F&B Operations**

**Experience:**
8–12+ Years

**Preferred Candidates From:**
ITC, Rebel Foods, EatClub (BOX8), Hyperpure Kitchens, Swish, QSR chains, large restaurant groups, etc.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time, On-site | Bengaluru

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Corporate Chef to lead culinary operations across our growing restaurant business.

The role will be responsible for maintaining food quality and consistency across outlets, managing central kitchen operations, developing and implementing kitchen SOPs, controlling food costs, and building efficient kitchen teams.

We are looking for someone who understands both the culinary and commercial aspects of running a multi-outlet F&B business and can build scalable kitchen operations without compromising on taste or quality.

**What You'll Work On**

- Overseeing culinary operations across central kitchen and restaurant outlets.

- Maintaining consistency in taste, presentation, portion sizes and food quality.

- Developing and implementing standardised recipes, kitchen SOPs and operating processes.

- Managing menu execution, product quality and new product introductions.

- Optimising kitchen workflows, preparation processes and manpower requirements.

- Managing food costs, wastage, yields, inventory and kitchen productivity.

- Training and developing kitchen teams, chefs and outlet kitchen managers.

- Coordinating with procurement and supply chain teams on ingredients, vendors and product quality.

- Conducting regular kitchen audits and identifying operational improvements.

- Ensuring food safety, hygiene and statutory compliance across all kitchen operations.

**What We're Looking For**

- Proven experience as a Corporate Chef, Executive Chef, Head Chef or Culinary Operations Head.

- 8–12+ years of experience in restaurant operations, QSRs, multi-outlet food businesses or central kitchen environments.

- Strong expertise in Indian vegetarian cuisine, particularly North Indian food, gravies, dals, tandoori products, chaap, kebabs and Indian breads.

- Experience managing multiple kitchens, central kitchens or large-scale food production operations.

- Strong understanding of recipe standardisation, food costing, portion control, yield management and inventory management.

- Experience developing kitchen SOPs and implementing processes across multiple outlets.

- Ability to train, manage and build high-performing kitchen teams.

- Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene, quality control and FSSAI requirements.

- Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and improve kitchen productivity without compromising food quality.

- Commercial mindset with a strong understanding of food costs, labour costs, wastage and outlet-level profitability.

- Strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.

**How We'll Measure Success**

- Consistency of food quality and taste across all outlets.

- Food cost performance against agreed targets.

- Reduction in food wastage and preparation inefficiencies.

- Improved kitchen productivity and manpower utilisation.

- Successful implementation and adoption of kitchen SOPs.

- Central kitchen and outlet operational efficiency.

- Kitchen team performance, training and retention.

- Reduction in customer complaints related to food quality and consistency.

- Successful execution of menu launches and product improvements.

**Who Should Apply?**

Someone who has successfully managed culinary operations at scale and understands how to build systems around food.

You should be equally comfortable developing a dish, troubleshooting a kitchen operation, analysing food costs, training a team and ensuring that the same dish tastes identical across multiple outlets.

**The goal is simple: Build a kitchen operation that can scale without compromising the food.**

Today, the majority of our products fall under the Impulse category. Our bestseller is DESi POPz; we sell more than 90 lakh POPz per month. Our other categories include DESi Meetha, DESi Mints, and DESi Bytes. We have an integrated backend, i.e., we own the entire supply chain from sourcing to manufacturing.
  
  
GO DESi aims to be a sustainable brand with the larger purpose of becoming a beacon for non-zero-sum capitalism, where all stakeholders win.

As a R&D Chef – Patisserie & Sweets, you oversee all aspects of pastry and sweet production, menu creation, and team management within a professional kitchen. This role demands creativity, leadership, and deep expertise in pastry techniques and food safety standards.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage the daily preparation of all sweet items for exclusive store orders, strictly adhering to recipes, quality standards, and portion control optimized for online delivery.

Solid knowledge of traditional sweet-making methods, especially Bengali sweets. Basic knowledge of fusion concepts and a keen interest in flavour experimentation.

Must understand the Go Desi mission, vision, and target consumer palate, and prioritize initiatives that lead to repeat business.

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things and experimenting. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values. jobs.title: Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textiles
jobs.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
Quince is a US-based, hyper-growth tech retail start-up experiencing 100%+ YoY growth and serving millions of users each month. Backed by over USD 500 million in funding, we continue to scale rapidly. At Quince, we didn’t just build a $2B+ retail brand—we completely rewrote the playbook on cross-border e-commerce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage day-to-day product development timelines across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes, tracking milestones and escalating risks early.
* Serve as the central point of coordination across Merchandising, Sourcing, Fit, Technical Development, Materials, QA, Creative, and Vendors to ensure alignment on development status and dependencies.
* Ensure all required product documentation is accurate, complete, and ready prior to vendor handoff, including technical specifications, build documentation, testing requirements, and fit inputs.
* Coordinate and track all sample requests, shipments, reviews, fit requests, and revisions to drive efficiency and maintain momentum toward target timelines.
* Facilitate timely product reviews and approvals by Merchandising, Fit, and Technical teams; track testing requests and results to ensure quality outcomes are clearly communicated.
* Run in-person country development trips with Global Merchants, Global Fit, and Local PD teams to accelerate decision-making and strengthen vendor execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to support timely staging of materials and finished-goods production; coordinate delivery of photo samples to Creative to ensure marketing and launch readiness.
* Maintain clean, accurate, real-time data across all product development systems and tracking tools to ensure transparency and support fast execution.

**Qualifications required:**

* 10+ years in product development or factory-facing roles
* Deep functional category expertise, including product and material standards
* Extensive experience working directly with factories and sample rooms
* Comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity Highly organized, detail-oriented and analytical with focus on execution, problem-solving, improving processes and quality enhancement
* Clear communicator across language, cultural, and functional boundaries
* Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
* Continuous learner and highly curious; always open to considering new perspectives; proactive when changing course and facing added challenges
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
* Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.title: Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**
Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Sensory strategy and governance:**
Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.
  
  
**Sensory study design:**
Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.
  
  

* Panel leadership: Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:**
Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.
  
  
**Consumer and flavour intelligence:**
Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.
  
  
**Quality and manufacturing support:**
Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.
  
  
**Claims substantiation:**
Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.
  
  

* Digital and analytics: Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**


* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**


* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**
Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.
  
  
**Industry background:**
Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.
  
  
**Panel experience:**
Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.
  
  
**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**
**Internal:**
R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.
  
  

* External: Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**


* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
**Recruitment Scam Warning**
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

Regular

Bangalore Technical Centre

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Business**
Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
  
  
Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
  
  
Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’
  
  
**Purpose Of The Job**

* This role is responsible for developing cutting-edge, cost-effective packaging solutions for integrated circuits, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and manufacturability.
* Fully accountable for new product development – design > material selection > qualification > LVM > Offload and process engineer providing end to end technology & process development, covering conventional & advanced packages.
* Able to lead technically the team of experts, to achieve all the deliverables, through flawless execution on the NTI / NPI programs and service the customer timely.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Able to be hands-on, in designing DOE, Process characterization & optimization, develop manufacturable recipe meeting all the CTQ matrices & yield.
* Strong understanding of semiconductor packaging materials, processes, and failure mechanisms.
* Must be very familiar and hands-on experience on the TD / NPI methodology, covering all the process involved
* Provide direction, technical leadership and hands-on experience to ensure all different functional dept work in sync to achieve the common dept/org goal.
* Lead, understand, integrate and innovate to meet customers’ packaging requirements into a cost competitive DFM solution.
* To make a characterization plan and risk assessment for new and existing device requiring engineering support
* Understand systematic problem-solving methodology using qualified tools like ESDA/FMEA/SPC/DOE/MSA etc
* To drive yield and quality improvement
* Responsible for guiding NPI & Process SME’s in resolving yield and quality issues
* Able to define process flows and material sets. Source & characterize material. Develop and execute standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensure all designs meet quality and industry standards.
* Able to source, characterise & qualify new material required for packaging / technology
* Customer interface – handling TD / engineer activities / quality performance mtgs / manage issues
* Work with TPM / Customer for new NPI design win opportunities & technical issues.
* To drive material cost reduction programs, through value engineer program.
* Able to cohesively co-work with all supporting groups & operations team.

**Essential Attributes**

* All aspects of this job are NTI & Assembly Process Engineering plant wide, affecting operations.
* In depth know-how of DOE/SPC/FMEA/MSA/JMP and other problem-solving methodology tools.
* Proven record in process stabilization, yield improvement and high-volume manufacturing support.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Engineering or its equivalent.

**Desired Experience Level**

* Minimum 15 years of experience in TD Development, Assembly Process Engineering, in a multinational OSAT industry.
* Knowledgeable in package assembly process equipment & manufacturing.

This role is within the GRA Chemistry Manufacturing & Controls (CMC) and Devices organization, and will contribute to the team’s delivery of critical functions as follows
  
  

* With some supervision, supports the execution of post approval regulatory CMC activities for assigned products.
* Authors CMC regulatory submission documents and responses for agency queries for moderately complex submissions in partnership with SMEs and under supervision of the regulatory CMC product lead.
* Serves as a Regulatory CMC member on the global regulatory CMC product team, may act as the delegate for the GRA CMC Product Lead on Regulatory / Commercial project teams.
* Applies a strong understanding of global CMC regulations / guidelines to assess change controls, interpret requirements, organize CMC content, prepare compliant, submission-ready deliverables that will enhance the probability of regulatory success and regulatory compliance in alignment with department strategies (i.e. Core Dossier.)
* Ability to draw from precedents and other regulatory intelligence beyond regulations with a strong analytical and/or process understanding that enables the development of robust, accurate and approvable submissions.
* Independently prepares submission plans / timelines for moderately complex CMC post approval submissions.

***Accountabilities:***

jobs.title: Polymer Chemist (Biopolymers & Functionalization)
jobs.description:
Polymer Chemist – Biopolymers & Functionalisation @ BacAlt

BacAlt is hiring a hands-on polymer scientist to design, functionalise, and characterise next-gen biopolymers (bacterial cellulose, PGA, chitosan, alginates) for sustainable materials and cosmetic formulations.

Mid Senior-level role | MSc/PhD | 2-6 yrs exp | On-site Your City, India | ₹10-20 LPA CTC (depending on experience and expertise

Please fill the following "Getting to know you" form:

https://forms.gle/PAe8XtZA9UZV76bf8

Role Summary

- Design and modify biopolymers such as bacterial cellulose, poly-γ-glutamic acid, chitosan, and alginates to achieve targeted properties like rheology, adhesion, and barrier functions.

- Develop functionalisation strategies including grafting, crosslinking, esterification, click-type ligation, and ionic complexation.

- Establish structure-property relationships through experimental design, and validate with analytical techniques such as NMR, GPC, rheometry, and TGA.

- Integrate biopolymers into real product applications, troubleshoot performance issues, and collaborate across product and microbiology teams.

- Document experiments, support IP generation, and assist with scale-up processes.

Required Qualifications

- MSc or PhD in Polymer Chemistry, Materials Science, Organic Chemistry, or a related field.

- 2–6 years of R&D experience in polymer synthesis and modification, with expertise in biopolymers or hydrogel systems.

- Proven track record of translating polymer concepts into functioning prototypes with quantifiable outcomes (such as yield, stability, or mechanical improvements).

Preferred Experience

- Experience with biopolymers like bacterial cellulose, chitosan, hyaluronic acid, alginate, and protein-based materials.

- Familiarity with click-type and carbodiimide coupling chemistries for hydrophilic polymers.

- Start-up experience with high ownership, adaptability, and bias for action.

- Rheology and structure-property analysis expertise in complex formulations (personal care, coatings, biomaterials).

Demonstrable Outcomes

- Candidates should be ready to discuss 1–3 case studies showing successful progression of biopolymer products from concept to prototype and problem-solving in polymer chemistry.

jobs.title: Founder's Office - Generalist
jobs.description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
  
  
Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
  
  
Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top-tier global investors, 60+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Tackle founder-level problems. Dive into ambiguous questions (e.g., "How do we cut customer onboarding time by 40%?") and deliver a data-backed solution—process, product spec, or growth playbook
* Shadow → Own. Start by shadowing founders and executives across GTM, Product, and Operations, and quickly take ownership of initiatives with significant revenue, customer, or cost impact
* Be the connective tissue. Translate hard manufacturing realities from shop-floor SMEs into crisp product requirements; then turn those into value propositions sales can run with
* Scale what works. Systematize every win—dashboards, SOPs, automations—so the next team member can sprint from day 1
* Rinse, learn, repeat. Each quarter you'll rotate (sales → CS → product → biz ops), compounding domain depth while keeping a 10,000-foot strategic view

**You Might Thrive Here If You**

* Love messy problems. You run towards the smoke, disassemble chaos into first-principles, then rebuild in clean layers of logic & data
* Play in spreadsheets & slides with equal joy. Google Sheets in the morning; crisp narrative memo by lunch; client demo at 4 PM
* Have a bias for action. You'd rather ship v0.1 today and iterate than debate v2.0 for weeks
* Communicate like an engineer and a poet. Precision when the stakes are technical; story when hearts & budgets are on the line
* Are hungry—really hungry. Titles don't impress you; impact does. You measure weeks in learnings shipped
* Bring 1-5 years of high-intensity experience. Early-stage start-up, tier-one consulting, I-banking, ops in manufacturing—anything that shows you can out-execute peers

**Requirements**
**Must-Haves**

* 1-4 years of experience in start-up, consulting, business operations, product, or manufacturing.
* Engineering background from tier 1 / tier 2 colleges
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and presentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, bias for action, and comfort with ambiguity.
* Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Product, Operations, and CS.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience working with founders/CXOs or on strategic projects.
* Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, pharma/lifesciences, or enterprise tech.
* Experience with SQL, dashboards, automation, or process building.

**Benefits**

* Be part of a fast-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high-performing team building innovative AI-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

jobs.title: Jr.Chemist
jobs.description:

When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Junior Chemist
  
  
**Department:**
Central Laboratory - Proximate Analysis
  
  
**Location:**
ALS Testing Services India Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
**Reports To:**
Manager
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To perform sample preparation, analysis, calculations, result verification, and documentation for proximate and nutritional parameters in food, feed, and related matrices, ensuring compliance with ALS quality systems, ISO/IEC 17025 requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Perform sample receipt, preparation, homogenization, and analysis as per approved test methods and SOPs.
* Conduct testing for proximate parameters including Moisture, Ash, Protein, Fat, Crude Fibre, Dietary Fibre, Carbohydrates (by calculation), Energy, Salt, and related nutritional analyses.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment such as Moisture Analyzers, Ovens, Muffle Furnaces, Kjeldahl Systems, Dumas Protein Analyzers, Soxhlet/Fat Extraction Systems, Fiber Analyzers, Balances, and other laboratory instruments.
* Carry out routine calibration, performance verification, and basic troubleshooting of laboratory equipment.
* Review analytical data, quality control results, and calculations to ensure compliance with method acceptance criteria.
* Maintain accurate records of sample preparation, test results, calculations, worksheets, and laboratory documentation.
* Ensure compliance with laboratory quality requirements, ISO/IEC 17025 standards, and ALS procedures.
* Meet assigned sample throughput and turnaround time (TAT) requirements.
* Participate in method validation, verification, proficiency testing, and internal quality control programs.
* Maintain laboratory housekeeping, chemical inventory, reference materials, and consumables.
* Follow all laboratory safety, health, environmental, and compliance requirements.

Education & Qualification
  
  

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Food Science, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Agriculture, or related scientific discipline.

**Experience**

* 0-1 years of experience in a NABL/ISO 17025 accredited testing laboratory.

To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.

Please apply on-line and provide a resume & cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

:

Our Innovative Laboratory technologies & Services makes it easier for customers.

The core activities of the team include data mining and processing, Western blotting with state-of-art tools, high efficiency and high-resolution immuno-fluorescence imaging, immunohistochemistry, ChIP (Chromatin Immunoprecipitation), and gene-silencing to provide advance application tags to our antibody portfolio. The program's goal is high-quality product validation and product information creation to promote research use.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**
**Purpose:**
- Contribute to the antibody validation workflow. Understand target biology validation and validate antibodies for reproducibility using innovative methods and crafting data sets to enable market differentiation. The role of the successful candidate would entail demonstrating scientific proficiency in experimental planning and execution. Prior experience in working in a research team, with a proven track record of setting goals, handling work-related customer concerns, and ensuring timely delivery in alignment with the program goals. Proficiency in verbal and written communication of results in the workplace is helpful.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Acquire and utilize knowledge on key aspects of protein biology, to deliver results on antibody validation and characterization.
* Regular mining of literature and keeping oneself up to date with developments in field of antibody validation.
* Perform in a fast- paced environment towards antibody validation, with attention to detail and adherence to schedules.
* Informal leadership of team of scientists in matrix style operation, provide technical and operational supervision. Mentoring and training junior scientists in research, design and experimental execution, interpreting data and data presentation to collaborators and partners.
* Drive conceptualization within teams to enable development of successful protocols to address complex biological targets
* Partner with supporting functions such as product management, program management, and business development to meet program goals.

**Candidate Requirement**
:
  
  
**Education & Experience levels**
:
  
  

* Applicants should have a PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, genetics, immunology, biotechnology, computational biology or biochemistry with 2 to 3 years experience.

**Skills**
:
  
  

* Familiar with experimental workflow in cell and molecular biology, with extensive experience in the design and development of protein-assays, protein-protein interaction (using co-immunoprecipitation), or development of immunoassays.
* Proven and extensive experience in Flow cytometry, and ELISA. Good working knowledge of western blotting and immunofluorescence is desirable.
* Communication of research data and providing expert-level technical troubleshooting to resolve scientific problems and develop new protocols/methods.
* Good understanding of statistical and computational biology tools.
* Working knowledge of databases and programming languages is desirable.
* Experience in antibody development platforms is desirable.

jobs.title: Principal Scientist
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
The Principal Scientist will be instrumental in helping Precision achieve its goals of delivering exceptional services to Precision’s diverse, innovative and global biopharmaceutical clients. Working closely with the Directors and Lab Operations they will help implement the strategic scientific plan to support translational medicine research, primarily, but not solely, in the Immuno-Oncology and autoimmune/inflammatory space.
  
  
Key components will be focused on, analysis and verification of complex flow cytometry data, from validation to clinical sample analysis. Flow assays include but are not limited to immunophenotyping up to 40 markers, receptor occupancy assays, tetramer/dextramer assays as well as immunophenotyping flow-based assays, or other custom cell-based assays. Deep knowledge on flow data analysis and compensation using several Flow software such as Diva, Cytek SpectroFlow, FlowJo and Omics. Understanding of Flow application in clinical studies, including validation, QC steps, data analysis and GLP, CAP, CLIA documentations. Critical understanding of flow data and troubleshooting
  
  
The successful candidate will assist and be a resource for senior team members to support data analysis, documentations and timelines, that match client specifications/requirements. They should and be able to communicate the plan and progress to the line manager, along with executing and reporting the work according to agreed timelines and under the appropriate regulations (GLP, CAP, CLIA etc.). The role will provide technical expertise to the laboratory as needed, as well as the expectation is that a large part of training is provided “hands on”.
  
  
Work Mode: Hybrid
  
  
Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**

* Analysis and verification of complex flow cytometry data, from validation to clinical sample analysis.
* Critical understanding of flow data and troubleshooting
* Train technical staff how to perform flow analysis procedures. Devise and perform validation schema to ensure staff are superbly trained and competent.
* Hold one-on-one engagement meetings with direct reports, set goals, conduct performance reviews and set priorities for lab work
* Motivate team, share knowledge on FACS
* Write and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) to perform assays to meet client requirements and the level of regulatory compliance needed
* Generate technical reports and other communications required to present data
* Write posters and papers for submission to conference organizers and peer reviewed journals
* Write reviews and white papers
* Track KPI on data and labs
* Perform duties with high degree of independence, quality, and efficiency
* Act as internal expert on technical advances and industry
* Promote the company to local, regional, national, and international constituencies through networking, speaking engagements, activity in professional associations and publications

**Qualifications**
Minimum Required:
  
  

* Must have a Ph.D. in life sciences or relevant field (preferably Immunology, Cellular Biology)
* At least 8 years of full-time post-doctoral laboratory experience
* Flow cytometry experience is required (Data analysis of complex panels using Flow software).

**Other Required**

* Experience troubleshooting and timelines
* Experience in validation/qualification of assays to CAP/CLIA/GLP or ISO guidelines
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong communication skills
* Strong teamwork skills
* Experienced technical report generation
* Must be able to read, write, speak fluently and comprehend the English language

**Preferred**

* 10-15+ years’ experience as CORE lab member with leadership role as direct manager to flow cytometry team
* Industrial experience and/or management of outside collaborations is desirable

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.
  
  
Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.

Please be aware that fraudulent individuals and websites may impersonate Precision Medicine Group or its affiliates and attempt to obtain personal, financial, or banking information through fake job postings or employment offers. FlexAbility Physiotherapy and Sports Rehabilitation is a leading center in India dedicated to expert care and personalized recovery solutions. **Position Overview**
A dedicated Molecular Biology and Protein Biochemistry scientist is required to establish and grow Bangalore’s in-house capabilities in cell-based assays and protein analysis. The role will support current Biochemistry R&D projects and help develop workflows for future projects and product opportunities.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong experimental execution and troubleshooting skills with an innovative, business-oriented mindset. In addition to building robust laboratory workflows, the scientist will identify opportunities for new biochemistry projects and catalogue additions, explore market needs, investigate underperforming portfolio areas, and engage with customers and potential collaborators.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Establish and support in-house molecular biology, cell-based assay, and protein analysis capabilities within Bangalore Biochemistry R&D. Execute and troubleshoot workflows involving mammalian cell culture, protein extraction, GST-based assay support, SDS-PAGE, Western blotting, protein quantification, chemiluminescent detection, and application or product validation.
  
  
In partnership with cross-functional and global teams, translate scientific and customer needs into new project proposals, product and catalogue opportunities, and practical application data. Contribute to market and portfolio assessments, including investigation of low-selling products and recommendations for improvement, repositioning, or future development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish, execute, and continuously improve molecular biology and protein biochemistry workflows for Biochemistry R&D projects.
* Perform mammalian cell-based experiments, including cell handling, treatment planning, harvesting, and lysate preparation.
* Extract proteins using appropriate lysis buffers, protease and phosphatase inhibitors, and sample-stabilization conditions.
* Perform BCA or equivalent protein quantification assays and normalize samples for downstream analysis.
* Execute SDS-PAGE, protein transfer to PVDF membranes, Ponceau staining, Western blotting, antibody incubation, washing, and chemiluminescent detection.
* Support GST-based experimental workflows, including protein–probe interaction studies, control planning, and data interpretation.
* Optimize and troubleshoot protein-analysis workflows, addressing weak signal, high background, poor transfer, protein degradation, and inconsistent sample loading.
* Maintain accurate experimental records, raw data, image files, calculations, and technical reports.
* Draft and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation for cell biology and protein-analysis workflows.
* Propose new biochemistry projects and catalogue additions based on scientific developments, customer needs, application opportunities, and market research.
* Conduct or coordinate market and portfolio assessments; investigate low-selling products to understand potential technical, application, positioning, or customer-related factors and recommend appropriate next steps.
* Engage with customers to understand their workflows and challenges, discuss application needs, and support technical data generation and product validation.
* Identify and develop potential collaborations with internal teams, external researchers, customers, or other relevant partners.
* Support product and application validation, proof-of-concept studies, customer-facing technical data generation, and internal capability development.
* Coordinate with global R&D, application, product management, quality, EHS, and manufacturing teams as needed.
* Manage critical reagents, including antibodies, buffers, gels, membranes, protein ladders, cell-culture consumables, and assay reagents.
* Ensure compliance with laboratory safety, biological sample handling, chemical hygiene, and documentation requirements.
* Travel as required to support customer engagement, collaboration, project work, or business needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Cell Biology, or a related discipline.
* Preferably 6-10 years of relevant experience in industry or application-driven R&D.

**Required Technical Skills And Experience**

* Mammalian cell culture and cell-based assays, including treatment planning, harvesting, and lysate preparation.
* Protein extraction, sample stabilization, and BCA, Bradford, or equivalent protein quantification.
* SDS-PAGE, PVDF or nitrocellulose transfer, Ponceau staining, Western blotting, antibody optimization, and chemiluminescent imaging.
* Experimental design using appropriate positive, negative, no-light, no-treatment, and competitor controls.
* Strong knowledge of protein chemistry, molecular biology, and biochemical assay principles.
* Troubleshooting protein degradation, weak signal, non-specific bands, high background, uneven transfer, and loading variation.
* Preferred: probe-based assays or photo-affinity labelling; GST workflows; recombinant protein expression and purification; LC-MS, HPLC, or other orthogonal characterization; product or application development; GLP-like documentation and R&D quality systems.

**Behavioural and functional competencies**

* Innovative mindset with the ability to spot scientific, application, and business opportunities.
* Strong experimental planning and troubleshooting mindset, with the ability to guide and train scientific and technical staff and contribute to project planning.
* Good documentation discipline and awareness of data integrity.
* Ability to work independently in a newly developing capability area.
* Cross-functional communication with chemistry, biology, application, product, and commercial teams.
* Scientific curiosity and the ability to translate protocols into robust, reproducible workflows.
* Customer-oriented approach and openness to engaging with customers and collaborators.
* Ability to assess market feedback and portfolio performance and turn findings into actionable proposals.
* Safety-conscious laboratory working style.
* Ability to train junior scientists or technical staff as the capability expands.

We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
  
  
We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
  
  
**Summary**
The successful candidate for this role will be part of materials, chemical characterization and E&L team and will bring hands-on and technical leadership experience in trace analysis like E&L and Nitrosamines for medical device and drug products. This Research Scientist role will entail utilization of expertise in analytical chemistry, mass spectrometry and other related techniques to perform gap assessments for medical device and drug products requirements and support change control activities across the Renal and Acute Care businesses within Vantive.
  
  
The successful candidate is expected to also have a strategic mindset and will work closely with regulatory, quality, preclinical and product design owning leaders to enable investigations and characterization of trace impurities in drugs & devices to support on-market or new product programs. This role will also include planning and performing laboratory work in mass spectrometry including execution of laboratory studies at in-house laboratories and supervising in external CRO labs. The candidate will likely act as study director for multiple studies at any given time and is expected to have excellent skills in wet chemistry, spectroscopy, chromatography, mass spectrometry to enable efficient and effective execution of programs. The individual will author required reports (internal documentation and regulatory submissions) following pertinent internal and external guidelines that ensures safety and compliance of drugs or devices that Vantive makes. The candidate is expected to stay abreast of emerging sciences and technologies that influence chemical characterization for medical devices and drug products through active participation in relevant external forums / societies
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and qualify state of the art methods using LCMS/ GCMS/ HRMS for extractable and leachable study of medical devices and drug products.
* Strategize and design E&L study for medical devices and drug products.
* Ability to review complex analytical data pertaining to E&L and other trace analysis. Draw data interpretation and conclusions
* Should have hands on experience with structural elucidation, unknown compound identification.
* Develop strategies to effectively apply a risk-based scientific approach within a regulatory framework to support trace analysis/ E&L projects and change control activities.
* Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of subject matter experts (e.g. E&L, Materials, Biocompatibility and Toxicology) to develop trace analysis strategies that align to regulatory requirements for medical devices and drug products.
* Participate in E&L change control impact assessments when applicable to trace analysis and work with cross functional team members (design owners, E&L and materials SMEs, preclinical & toxicologists, etc.) to determine a comprehensive testing strategy through writing impact assessments, gap assessments, technical rationales and documents related to such change controls.
* Maintain and apply current knowledge of relevant Quality System Regulations and other regulatory requirements related to chemical characterization during product development, design and safety.
* Interact across functions (Design Owning Organization, Project Management Organization, Regulatory Affairs, Preclinical, etc.) to understand products and therapies, as well as business, technical, and regulatory requirements to meet project needs.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience & expertise in Extractables & Leachable with hands-on experience in mass spectrometry (HRMS, LCMS and GCMS) and study design for medical devices and drug products.
* Knowledge of regulatory expectations related to trace analysis for drugs and devices.
* Performing change control in a GMP environment.
* Experience of working in global cross-functional teams for trace analysis projects
* Independent problem solver who can use a methodical approach to develop solutions and make recommendations.

**Education And/or Experience**

* Ph.D. / Post graduate degree(M Pharm, MSc, MS) in scientific discipline (Pharmaceutical, Analytical or Organic chemistry preferred) with a minimum of 10 years of relevant (E&L, Mass spec) experience.

jobs.title: Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description:
**We’re hiring |**
Experienced
**Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer**

**Knoxx Foods Australia · Bengaluru (Bangalore)**

This role is based in Bengaluru and requires frequent travel to partner factories across India and willingness to travel overseas when required.

Knoxx Foods develops ingredients and meal components for Australian food manufacturers, including shelf-stable rice and pulses, dry blends and coatings. We’re looking for someone who has managed production at third-party food factories and can represent Knoxx on the factory floor. You’ll oversee how our products are made, how our formulations are protected and whether each order leaves the factory on time and in full.

**What you’ll do**

* **Manage production at partner factories.**
  Agree schedules for trials and commercial runs, confirm raw material and line availability, and track output and yields. When a run falls behind, agree a recovery plan with the factory and follow it through.
* **Verify product and process quality.**
  Conduct frequent site audits to assess facilities, testing capabilities and production practices. Observe live runs to verify that operators follow approved standard operating procedures (SOPs). Check batch records, traceability and test results against Knoxx specifications, then verify that corrective actions work.
* **Protect Knoxx’s intellectual property.**
  Before sharing formulations, process instructions or customer specifications, verify that each factory has confidentiality and access controls in place. During audits, check who can access the information, how printed and electronic copies are controlled, and whether obsolete versions have been withdrawn. Escalate suspected breaches and follow corrective actions through to closure.
* **Plan packaging ahead of every run.**
  Work backwards from the dispatch date to determine when approved pouches, labels and cartons must reach the factory. Confirm quantities, stock and supplier lead times, then track orders through receipt so shortages can be resolved before packing begins.
* **Optimise packaging.**
  Trial pouch sizes, carton configurations and pallet layouts with factories, suppliers and Knoxx R&D. Assess product protection, packing-line performance, waste, cost and container utilisation before recommending changes.
* **Ensure timely factory dispatch.**
  Confirm finished quantities, labels, packing lists, QA release status and freight collection against the committed date. Track each order until it leaves the facility and alert our Australian operations team early enough to act on any shipment risk.

**What you’ll bring**

At least 3 or more years hands-on experience managing production at third-party food manufacturers or co-packers is
**essential**
. You should also have practical experience auditing food factories, checking compliance with SOPs, handling confidential technical information, planning packaging and coordinating dispatch. A qualification in food technology, food science, food processing or a related discipline is a
**must**
.

**What you’ll get**

* Attractive Salary
* Company laptop and phone
* Reimbursement of interstate and overseas expenses.

**To apply**
, send me your CV by LinkedIn message with your current location, earliest firm joining date and
**confirmation that you’re available for domestic and overseas travel as described**
.

**Description**
The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate(DE) is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Sr. Compliance Associate(DE), your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.
  
  
**Skills**

* Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.)
* Basic understanding of SQL, can self-service defined queries and make simple changes to retrieve data from a database
* Knowledgeable in Customer Relationship Management tools, managing customer data and tracking interactions
* Attention to detail and ability to analyze and identify patterns across data sets and information
* Problem-solving skills, with the ability to find solutions through logic, intuition, creativity, and design thinking
* Commitment to investigation, research, and diving deep to seek facts
* Ability to understand, interpret, critique, analyses and communicate data

**About The Team**
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
  
  
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

jobs.title: Staff Technical Analyst [T500-31009]
jobs.description:
**About Albertsons Companies Inc.:**

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. operates over 2,200 stores across 35 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners across the United States, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others, serve more than 36 million U.S customers each week.

We build and shape technology solutions that solve customers’ problems every day, making things easier for them when they shop with us online or in a store. We have made bold, strategic moves to migrate and modernize our core foundational capabilities, positioning ourselves as the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company in the industry.

Our success is built on a one-team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we are transforming shopping into an experience that is easy, efficient, fun and engaging.

**About Albertsons Companies India:**

At Albertsons Companies India, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company’s technology journey to support millions of customers’ lives every day.

At the Albertsons Companies India, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology & Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165-year-old American retailer. At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being.

**Analytics - Business Analyst**

**Role Summary:**

This role is responsible for turning business questions into structured analyses, meaningful metrics, measurable KPIs, actionable insights, and decision- ready recommendations. The role combines traditional analytics, statistical methods, and business translation to improve planning, performance, and process decisions across the function. It contributes to team and business goals by identifying opportunities, testing hypotheses, and enabling stakeholders to act on reliable, well-explained data. The role also helps determine how a problem should be solved using data, whether through reporting, BI, traditional analytics, or advanced data science methods.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end analytical problem solving by translating business questions into hypotheses, analysis plans, and decision-ready recommendations.
* Assess business problems and determine the right data approach, including reporting, BI, traditional analytics, or data science.
* Own KPI design, metric definitions, dashboards, reports, and recurring insight packs that improve visibility into business performance.
* Analyze large structured and semi-structured datasets using SQL, Python, Excel, and BI tools to identify trends, risks, anomalies, root causes, and opportunities.
* Apply statistical methods such as hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, segmentation, cohort analysis, and experimentation design to evaluate initiatives and quantify impact.
* Design and assess A/B tests, interpret statistical and practical significance, and communicate business implications clearly.
* Support basic predictive analysis and time-series forecasting where relevant, including simple model development, validation, and scenario analysis.
* Collaborate with business, product, operations, engineering, and data teams to improve data quality, instrumentation, analytical workflows, and action tracking.
* Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reproducible, and well documented through validation checks, notebook discipline, version control, and clear metric logic.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Experience:**

* Experience in data analysis, business analysis, business intelligence/reporting, or techno-functional analytics roles.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, advanced Excel, and one BI platform such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working with Jupyter notebooks, GCP, and BigQuery.
* Proven experience in exploratory data analysis, reporting, dashboarding, data validation, and several of the following: statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, segmentation, cohort analysis, predictive modelling, time-series forecasting, or experimentation design.
* Experience partnering with stakeholders to frame business questions, define KPIs and success metrics, and translate findings into practical actions.
* Experience working cross-functionally and translating business needs into analytical or technical deliverables.

**Skills:**

* Strong technical skills in SQL, Python, Excel, data wrangling, dashboarding, statistical methods, data visualization, and basic ML workflows.
* Working knowledge of statistical and analytical libraries such as scikit-learn and statsmodels for basic modelling and analysis.
* Functional expertise in problem structuring, metric design, root-cause analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal reasoning.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain methods, assumptions, and recommendations clearly to non- technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset, high attention to detail, data-quality discipline, and comfort working independently in ambiguous environments.

**AI Skills (Mandatory):**

* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools for daily engineering tasks to enhance productivity, optimize effort, and ensure cost-aware AI assistance.
* Familiarity with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including semantic layers for data retrieval and grounding Large Language Model (LLM) responses.
* Conceptual understanding of LLM-based applications (e.g., chatbots, Q&A systems), encompassing prompt engineering, context management, and response generation.
* Exposure to agentic and multi-agent AI systems, including agent roles, tool utilization, memory management, and workflow orchestration.
* [Good to have] Practical experience with LLM application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, or Google GenAI tools) for prototyping and integrating AI-driven solutions.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with Git-based workflows, reusable notebook practices, and collaboration with data science or ML teams.
* Exposure to advanced analytics techniques such as forecasting, causal inference, or uplift measurement.
* Domain experience in retail, grocery, e-commerce, operations, pricing, supply chain, marketing, or customer analytics.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About This Role**
The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* Keep things documented: Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good To Have**

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:***
This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.

jobs.title: Consultant, Product - Tech, Insight
jobs.description:
Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
This is a Consulting role for 3 - 6 months
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
**Founded**
with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*
