jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position: Research Assistant**

**Summary**

The role of a Research Assistant is to support and contribute to ongoing research activities under the Mini Research Grant project titled
*“Degradation Study of Supercapacitor due to Ripple Current”*
at the School of Engineering, Chanakya University. The position involves assisting in experimental investigations, laboratory activities, data collection and analysis, and technical documentation to advance research on supercapacitor degradation under power-electronic stress, particularly in electric vehicle applications.

**Duration:**
6 months

**Responsibilities**

**Research and Experimental Activities:**

* Assist in conducting research activities related to supercapacitor degradation under power-electronic stress in electric vehicles.
* Support the development and execution of research plans, experimental procedures, and technical investigations.
* Conduct laboratory experiments involving supercapacitors, programmable power sources, electronic loads, and electrical measurement instruments.
* Assist in setting up, operating, and troubleshooting experimental hardware and laboratory equipment.
* Collect, process, analyse, and systematically document experimental data and observations.

**Technical Analysis and Documentation:**

* Conduct literature reviews on supercapacitor technology, degradation mechanisms, ripple current effects, and related power-electronic applications.
* Assist in analysing experimental results and interpreting the effects of electrical stress on supercapacitor performance and degradation.
* Prepare technical reports, research presentations, experimental records, and other project-related documentation.
* Contribute to the preparation of research papers and publications arising from the project.

**Laboratory Management and Support:**

* Assist in maintaining relevant laboratory equipment (power electronics and drives, and energy storage systems), experimental setups, and research-related records.
* Ensure proper handling and operation of electrical and electronic instruments during experimental investigations.
* Follow established laboratory safety procedures and maintain a systematic and organised research environment.

**Collaboration and Research Support:**

* Work collaboratively with the Principal Investigator, faculty members, and other internal and external research personnel to achieve the objectives of the project.
* Participate in research discussions, project reviews, and technical meetings as required.
* Contribute to other project-related research activities and responsibilities as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

**Qualifications Required:**

**Essential Qualifications:**

* B.Tech./B.E. in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA, subject to university norms.
* Ability to conduct laboratory experiments and work comfortably with electrical and electronic hardware setups.

**Desirable Qualifications:**

* M.Tech./M.E. specialization in Power Electronics, Electric Drives, Energy Storage Systems, or a related area.
* Hands-on experience with programmable electrical sources, power converters, power supplies, electronic loads, electrical measurement instruments, or data acquisition systems.
* Experience in MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice, or equivalent computational tools.
* Previous research project experience or publications related to power electronics, energy storage, or electric vehicle systems.
* Ability to work independently in a research laboratory and systematically document experimental results.

**Experience Required**

* Fresh graduates may apply.
* Relevant laboratory, research, or project experience is desirable.

**Skills Required**

* Fundamentals of electrical engineering principles, power electronics, and energy storage technologies.
* Familiarity with electrical measurement instruments and hardware circuit development.
* Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent engineering simulation tools is desirable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Dedication to maintaining laboratory safety, and research integrity.

**Duration: Initial appointment for a period of six months, with the possibility of extension based on project requirements and performance.**

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Manager

### 

**What We Believe In**
----------------------

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, quality control solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

In this role, we are looking for an R&D Engineer – System 800xA & Quality Control System (QCS) to join our Process Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the validation, testing, and lifecycle support of ABB System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions, ensuring high-quality, reliable, and secure industrial automation software for the Pulp & Paper industry.

Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies, perform end-to-end system integration testing, and collaborate with Product Management, Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to deliver robust automation solutions while driving continuous quality improvements.

This role is contributing to the Process Industries – System 800xA & QCS Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for**
--------------------------------------

* Develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies for System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, system, cybersecurity, and end-to-end testing to ensure product quality, reliability, and compliance with ABB engineering standards.
* Validate industrial automation solutions by testing DCS integrations, QCS control strategies, process parameters, alarm management, historical data, industrial communication, and overall system performance across diverse operating scenarios.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Software Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to manage defect lifecycles, support release readiness, participate in Agile ceremonies, and deliver high-quality software using modern testing methodologies, Azure DevOps, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
* Drive engineering excellence by developing test automation frameworks, improving validation processes, mentoring team members, maintaining technical documentation, supporting customer demonstrations, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications for the Role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in software testing or validation for Industrial Automation, DCS, PLC, SCADA, or Quality Control Systems, with hands-on experience in ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, and Control Builder M.
* Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional, system, integration, regression, simulation, and end-to-end validation, along with experience using Azure DevOps, Git/TFS, and test automation frameworks.
* Experience with Quality Control Systems (QCS), DCS integration, industrial process control, and Pulp & Paper applications is preferred, with knowledge of IEC 61131-3 programming and industrial automation architectures.
* Understanding of Industrial Cybersecurity (IEC 62443), automated testing practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and Agile software development methodologies is considered an advantage.
* Professional certifications such as ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent testing certifications are preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional global teams and drive continuous quality improvement initiatives.

**More About Us**
-----------------

ABB's Process Industries business serves customers across mining, minerals, metals, cement, pulp & paper, battery manufacturing, food & beverage, and other industrial sectors by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.

Our R&D organization develops next-generation industrial automation software, distributed control systems, Quality Control Systems (QCS), cloud-enabled digital platforms, and intelligent engineering solutions that help customers optimize manufacturing processes and accelerate digital transformation. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced automation technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial operations.

At ABB, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams to build world-class automation and quality control solutions while advancing your expertise in industrial software, system validation, digital engineering, and AI-assisted testing. We foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion where every individual is empowered to make a meaningful impact.

ABB is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment is subject to applicable background verification and pre-employment screening in accordance with ABB policies.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

jobs.title: Operations Manager

**About PlayShifu:**

PlayShifu is one of the fastest-growing technology startups creating AR-powered educational toys that make learning fun and interactive. Our award-winning products are sold across 35+ countries, and we're continuing to expand our global footprint.

We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to lead our sourcing, procurement, and international logistics functions. This role will be instrumental in building a resilient supplier network, driving cost efficiencies, managing global freight flows, and ensuring seamless product availability across markets. If you thrive in a fast-paced consumer products environment and enjoy solving complex supply chain challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

**What You'll Do:**

**Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management**

* Own end-to-end sourcing strategy for product components, packaging materials, and finished goods across domestic and international suppliers.
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop new suppliers to improve cost, quality, scalability, and risk diversification.
* Lead commercial negotiations with manufacturers and vendors to achieve cost savings, favorable payment terms, and improved service levels.
* Conduct supplier performance reviews and establish KPIs around quality, lead times, responsiveness, and delivery performance.
* Develop alternate sourcing strategies and contingency plans to mitigate supply chain disruptions.

**International Freight & Logistics Management**

* Manage global inbound and outbound freight operations across ocean, air, courier, and multimodal transportation networks.
* Negotiate freight contracts and rates with freight forwarders, shipping lines, customs brokers, and logistics service providers.
* Drive freight cost optimization initiatives while maintaining target service levels and launch timelines.
* Monitor international trade regulations, customs requirements, duties, tariffs, HS classifications, and import/export compliance across key markets.
* Ensure smooth movement of goods between suppliers, manufacturing partners, warehouses, and customers across multiple countries.
* Analyze freight performance and proactively resolve shipping delays, customs issues, and capacity constraints.

**Supply Chain Operations**

* Own supply and demand planning processes in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product teams.
* Manage inventory levels across warehouses, retail channels, distributors, and e-commerce platforms.
* Coordinate new product launches by ensuring sourcing readiness, packaging compliance, labeling, and logistics execution.
* Oversee fulfillment operations for global retailers, distributors, marketplaces, and DTC channels.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across planning, procurement, warehousing, and transportation functions.
* Track and report key operational metrics, freight spend, sourcing savings, inventory health, and supplier performance.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and lead a high-performing operations team in a fast-growing, global business environment.
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Leadership teams to support growth objectives.
* Manage operational escalations with suppliers, logistics partners, and customers through structured root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, and BI tools is preferred.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ownership mindset with the ability to make decisions in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling environment.

**Who we are :**

Money. A subject that’s always on our mind. We go through a rollercoaster of emotions when it comes to money. That’s why at Jupiter, our mission is to enable people to improve their relationship with money.

We are a financial services platform that leverages technology to offer our customers seamless and user-friendly products related to banking, loans, and investments. So whether it’s a savings account, credit cards, investment and payments, it's all on Jupiter. We also help users cut through the banking jargons, offer smart insights based on spending and provide users with a range of new age features to enable and make sense of their finances.

  

**Our journey so far:**

Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea : to create a modern, customer-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.

  

From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2.7 million + happy users on Jupiter.

  

Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.

  

We've embraced cutting-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like-minded folks to join the crew.

  

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* You create simple prototypes to create flows and are well aware of the design system and use it appropriately.
* You seek continuous feedback on your work from senior designers, Product and engineering counterparts
  

  

**What is needed for this role:**

* 4+ years of professional experience as a product designer at consumer-focused tech companies
* A portfolio that demonstrates robust product design work and design expertise
* Experience with working with Figma & the Adobe Creative Suite. A keen eye for interaction design.
  

  

**Why you should work with us:**

* We like people who behave like owners, and we place a high regard on those who take ownership and see projects through to completion.
* We take pleasure in tackling meaningful problems by understanding pain points and developing intuitive experiences that delight customers.
* We appreciate those who can participate in healthy conflict and are able to commit to every decision as if it were their own. We value consent, over consensus.
* In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we consistently set higher standards. If you crave continuous learning, growth, and improvement in a dynamic environment, choosing Jupiter is the right move.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to learn, design, develop, and test generative **AI and** agentic **AI applications**, intelligent workflows, and solutions powered by large language models (LLMs). You will work alongside experienced engineers, architects, scientists, and product teams to solve real-world problems using modern AI technologies.

* Embedded SAP PP/DS or advanced planning experience.
* Statistical Process Control (SPC) and quality analytics.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, food and beverage or chemical industries.

Further you have 3+ years of experience in project management, business analysis, or digital transformation roles, preferably in a tech or industrial setting

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Global Commercial Leader - IDS

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to manage and own global commercial enablement initiatives and digital tools that support business growth and commercial excellence. You will collaborate closely with global, regional, and cross-functional stakeholders to enhance sales effectiveness, improve commercial processes, and accelerate digital transformation across the organization. You will also play a key role in developing training programs, optimizing bid and proposal processes, improving commercial reporting, and supporting pricing strategies for digital and software offerings.

**Work model:** #LI – Hybrid

**This role is contributing to the Automation Process Industries Digital (AUPI) business globally. Main stakeholders include Commercial Enablement, Digital, Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Finance, and Bid & Proposal teams.**

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Managing sales enablement initiatives, including training programs, webinars, learning sessions, and development of commercial enablement content and tools.
* Standardizing and continuously improving bid and proposal processes, performance metrics, and adoption of AI-enabled proposal solutions.
* Supporting digital opportunity reporting, performance analytics, recurring revenue tracking, and subscription business management through effective data governance and collaboration.
* Maintaining and enhancing pricing methodologies, subscription pricing tools, and long-term digital growth planning in alignment with ABB policies and commercial objectives.

**Our team dynamics**

You will join a collaborative, globally diverse team, where you will have the opportunity to help shape commercial transformation initiatives, work with digital technologies, and contribute to ABB's growth strategy.

**Qualifications for the role**

* You are highly skilled in commercial operations, sales enablement, pricing management, business analytics, and digital transformation within a B2B environment.
* You have 10+ years of experience in commercial roles, pricing, sales operations, commercial excellence, or related functions in a matrixed and multi-regional organization.
* You possess advanced knowledge of CRM platforms (Salesforce/SFDC), Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions.
* You are focused on stakeholder collaboration, project management, process improvement, and promoting adoption of digital and AI-enabled solutions.
* You hold an MBA or bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related discipline.
* You have knowledge of subscription-based business models, recurring revenue management, commercial pricing strategies, and sales operations best practices.
* You are comfortable communicating in English and collaborating effectively with global stakeholders across multiple regions.

**What's in it for you?**

* Work in a global role with broad exposure across regions, business lines, and leadership teams.
* Support digital transformation and commercial excellence initiatives that impact business performance.
* Collaborate with industry experts and cross-functional teams in a highly innovative environment.
* Contribute to the adoption of emerging technologies and AI-enabled solutions within commercial operations.
* Build your knowledge in subscription business models, pricing strategies, and digital commercial tools.

**More about us**

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry knowledge coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  
  

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

As a Senior Software Engineer within Disney Experiences Technology, you will help create immersive digital products that bring Disney’s stories to life across theme parks, resorts, cruise vacations, and consumer experiences worldwide. In this role, you will operate as a skilled, independent worker who solves complex problems, mentors less experienced colleagues, and contributes effective, high-quality solutions that enhance guest and business experiences.

**Responsibilities:**

In this role, you will design, build, test, and maintain software solutions that support end-to-end guest and business journeys across Disney Experiences, from travel and vacation planning to in-park and retail interactions. You will work with minimal guidance, act as a resource for teammates, and apply your problem-solving skills to deliver effective, scalable systems that help Disney provide creative, customer-focused, and innovative experiences around the world. This role matters because it ensures our technology is reliable, performant, and easy to evolve, requiring a proficient engineer who is detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to explain complex concepts clearly.

* Conceive, design, develop, test, and implement software components, enhancements, fixes, and new applications across web and cloud-based platforms.
* Contribute to and sometimes lead the design and implementation of custom applications, integrations, microservices, and APIs that support high-volume, highly scalable systems.
* Work independently to deliver assigned tasks from planning through implementation, adapting to changing business requirements while maintaining code quality and performance.
* Participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives) and collaborate with product, design, QA, and other stakeholders to define scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Perform regular code reviews, enforce coding standards, and support unit, behavioral, and integration testing to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant software.
* Monitor applications using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, or similar solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and proactively improve system reliability and run quality.
* Explain difficult or sensitive technical concepts to non-technical partners and collaborate across teams to align on requirements, architecture, and implementation approaches.
* Offer guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers by sharing best practices, providing constructive feedback, and modeling effective problem-solving approaches.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong proficiency in Java for building production-grade, scalable applications and services.
* Experience developing front-end applications using JavaScript frameworks such as Angular and/or React, and back-end services using Node.js.
* Knowledge of microservices architectures, RESTful web services, and API design for high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
* Proficiency in object-oriented programming, design principles, and common design patterns for multi-tier web applications.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Pub/Sub or Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of unit testing, behavioral or component testing, and continuous integration practices and tools.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar platforms to support production systems.
* Ability to work effectively in agile teams, collaborate with cross-functional partners, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
* Minimum Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Years Of Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including full software development lifecycle responsibilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing cloud-based or cloud-native solutions using AWS or similar platforms, including managed and serverless technologies such as Docker, ECS, Lambda, or Kubernetes.
* Database design and implementation experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, such as MariaDB, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
* Experience with QA and software analytics tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release management systems.
* Background in hospitality, travel, vacation ownership, licensing, or commerce-related domains.

  
**Disclaimer**  

This position is with Walt Disney Attractions Technology LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Experiences.

To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here.

Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

jobs.title: Technical Lead Engineer - Electrical
jobs.description:
* **Technical Lead Engineer -Electrical**

    
    

  **Your Role:**

    

  The Technical Lead Engineer - Electrical is responsible for leading the design, development, validation, and delivery of electronic hardware solutions for automotive applications. This role serves as the primary technical focal point for assigned products, systems, or projects, ensuring robust, high-quality, and cost-effective designs that meet customer and business requirements.

  The Technical Lead Engineer provides technical leadership across the product development lifecycle, coordinates cross-functional engineering activities, drives technical decision-making, and supports the professional development of team members.

  In addition to individual design responsibility, the **Technical Lead Engineer -Electrical** is expected to drive technical decisions, lead design reviews, resolve complex cross-functional issues, mentor engineers and ensure that hardware designs meet customer, quality, reliability, cost and timing objectives.

    
    

  This distinction is aligned with your internal career framework, where progression moves from supervised design to independent design and subsequently to technical mentoring, expert knowledge and leadership of complex problem resolution.

    
    

  **Key Responsibilities**

  + Lead the design, development, validation, and delivery of electronic hardware solutions for automotive applications.
  + Define and drive technical solutions, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, engineering standards, quality objectives, and project targets.
  + Serve as the technical lead for assigned products, systems, or projects, providing direction and guidance throughout the development lifecycle.
  + Coordinate and align activities across cross-functional teams, including Systems, Software, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain.
  + Lead technical reviews, risk assessments, issue resolution, and root cause analysis activities.
  + Provide technical leadership in design changes, deviation assessments, and escalation management.
  + Support customer and supplier interactions by representing the hardware engineering organization in technical discussions and reviews.
  + Mentor and support engineers through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.
  + Drive continuous improvement initiatives, engineering best practices, design reuse, and innovation.
  + Ensure successful execution of project deliverables with accountability for technical quality, timing, and performance.

  **Technical ownership**

  + Own electrical design of an ECU, major subsystem or complex electronic module.
  + Translate system/customer requirements into robust HW architecture and detailed electrical requirements.
  + Define processor/SoC, memory, PMIC, power, communication and peripheral architecture.
  + Make component and design trade-offs considering technical performance, cost, availability, qualification, lifecycle and supply-chain risk.
  + Drive schematic design from concept through design freeze and production release.

  **Design analysis & technical sign-off**

  + Drive SI, PI, WCCA, power sequencing, timing and electrical-interface analysis.
  + Review simulation results and ensure appropriate design margins.
  + Lead schematic and PCB design reviews.
  + Review critical high-speed, high-current, RF-sensitive and EMC-sensitive PCB implementation.
  + Define technical risk mitigation before DV/PV.

  **Bring-up, debug & problem solving**

  + Lead complex board bring-up and HW/SW integration debugging.
  + Define structured root-cause-analysis approaches for electrical, EMC and environmental failures.
  + Use measurements and engineering analysis to differentiate HW, SW, component, PCB and system-level issues.
  + Drive corrective actions and verify effectiveness.
  + Provide technical leadership during critical program escalations.

  **EMC, validation & design robustness**

  + Drive design-for-EMC principles early in the architecture and PCB design.
  + Review EMC/EMI test plans and results.
  + Lead resolution of radiated/conducted emissions, immunity and ESD issues.
  + Evaluate electrical/environmental validation failures and determine design impact.
  + Ensure appropriate design margin and robustness before design release.

  **Cross-functional technical leadership**

  + Work closely with Systems, ECAD, Mechanical, EMC, Software, Validation, Functional Safety, Manufacturing and Component Engineering teams.
  + Interface technically with semiconductor and component suppliers.
  + Support customer technical discussions and design reviews.
  + Mentor junior engineers and improve engineering methods, checklists and reusable design solutions.
  + Drive lessons learned and reuse across programs.

  **Required Qualifications**

  + Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent.
  + Typically 8–12+ years of automotive or equivalent complex electronic hardware design experience.
  + Strong hands-on electronic circuit design and debugging capability.
  + Strong understanding of SoCs/MCUs, memories, PMICs, power supplies and communication interfaces.
  + Experienced in schematic design, PCB design reviews and component selection.
  + Practical knowledge of SI/PI/WCCA and EMC/EMI design.
  Experience taking hardware through prototype DV PV+ production.
  + Demonstrated capability to independently solve complex electrical/system problems.
  + Ability to lead technical reviews and communicate technical risks to engineering and program leadership.

  **Preferred Expertise**

  + Automotive cockpit/infotainment, ADAS, cameras, radar or domain controllers
  + Qualcomm, Telechips, TI, NXP, Infineon/AURIX or comparable automotive processors/MCUs
  + LPDDR4/LPDDR5, NOR Flash, eMMC/UFS

**About the Role**

Responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end product development, formulation development, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and supply-chain activities for nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, personal care and allied product categories.

The role involves translating client requirements and market opportunities into commercially viable products through coordination with contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, internal business development teams and quality/regulatory functions.

**Key Responsibilities**A. Product Development & NPD

· Manage the product development lifecycle from initial concept and client requirement assessment to formulation finalisation, sampling, validation and commercial manufacturing.

· Evaluate new product opportunities based on market trends, consumer requirements, ingredient innovations and commercial feasibility.

· Coordinate with contract manufacturers and technical teams for new product development across nutraceutical, functional food, pharmaceutical and personal care categories.

· Drive formulation development, optimisation and improvement in terms of ingredient selection, active concentrations, excipient systems, flavour profiles, stability and product performance.

· Evaluate innovative delivery formats, including gummies, powders, sachets, tablets, capsules, liquids, RTDs and other functional formats.

· Coordinate prototype development, sample evaluation, sensory assessment and subsequent formulation modifications.

· Prepare and manage New Product Development (NPD/NPDP) documentation and development timelines.

· Coordinate technical feasibility assessments for new ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and product formats.

B. Contract Manufacturing, Technical Coordination and Scale up

· Identify, evaluate and coordinate with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Conduct manufacturing facility visits and technical assessments to evaluate production capabilities, infrastructure, processes and quality systems.

· Coordinate product development and commercial manufacturing activities with external manufacturing partners.

· Review manufacturing feasibility, process limitations, production capacities, minimum order quantities and lead times.

· Monitor manufacturing progress, identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to ensure timely execution.

· Establish manufacturing timelines and align internal and external stakeholders on development, procurement, production and dispatch schedules.

· Coordinate with manufacturing partners for process improvements, production optimisation and resolution of technical issues.

C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control Coordination

· Coordinate manufacturer QA/QC teams to establish and maintain product quality standards.

· Review product specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), raw material documentation and finished product quality parameters.

· Establish and coordinate quality checkpoints across product development, sampling, manufacturing and finished goods evaluation.

· Coordinate product testing, analytical evaluation, stability studies and quality investigations.

· Review product samples for sensory attributes, physical characteristics and compliance with agreed specifications.

· Identify quality deviations and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with manufacturing partners.

· Ensure alignment between approved product specifications, manufacturing requirements and final commercial batches.

· Support quality documentation and product release-related activities.

D. Regulatory Affairs & Compliance

· Coordinate regulatory requirements for product development, manufacturing and commercialisation.

· Support FSSAI compliance, including product documentation, ingredient permissibility, product categorisation and labelling requirements.

· Review product labels, ingredient declarations, nutritional information, claims and regulatory artwork.

· Coordinate with regulatory teams and manufacturing partners for required licences, certifications, declarations and technical documentation.

· Support preparation and review of Free Sale Certificates, product descriptions, technical dossiers and other export-related documentation.

· Coordinate regulatory feasibility assessments for domestic and international product opportunities.

· Ensure product development and commercialisation activities remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Product Costing & Commercial Feasibility

· Coordinate product costing exercises for new and existing products.

· Evaluate ingredient costs, excipient systems, manufacturing charges, packaging costs and other associated expenses.

· Work with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain commercial quotations and develop product cost sheets.

· Identify opportunities for formulation optimisation, alternative ingredient sourcing and manufacturing efficiencies to improve product economics.

· Evaluate MOQ, batch sizes, production yields and manufacturing feasibility against commercial requirements.

· Support business development teams with technical and commercial inputs during client discussions and product proposals.

· Assess product feasibility from both technical and commercial perspectives before proceeding with development or commercial production.

F. Product Portfolio & Market Research

· Conduct market research to identify emerging nutraceutical ingredients, product formats, consumer trends and innovation opportunities.

· Evaluate new ingredients and technologies for potential inclusion in the company's product portfolio.

· Analyse competitor products, market positioning, formulation approaches and potential differentiation opportunities.

· Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion through innovative formulations, ingredient combinations and delivery formats.

· Coordinate technical evaluation and commercial feasibility of new product concepts.

· Support product positioning through technical information, formulation inputs and product development insights.

G. Commercial strategy

· Identify, evaluate and develop strategic relationships with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Develop commercial strategies to generate business through manufacturing partners by leveraging GCV's product portfolio, proprietary ingredients, formulation capabilities and innovation pipeline.

· Identify opportunities to introduce GCV-developed formulations and ready-to-launch products into manufacturers' existing client networks and business portfolios.

· Engage with manufacturers to understand their existing capabilities, client base, market reach and potential business opportunities for GCV.

H. Cross-functional Coordination & Project Management

· Act as a central coordination point between business development and external vendors.

· Develop and monitor project timelines covering formulation, sampling, procurement, packaging, testing, manufacturing and dispatch.

· Conduct regular follow-ups with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project milestones.

JOB DESCRIPTIONPosition: Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer

**Department:** Machine Shop / Production  
**Designation:** Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Location:** Thirumudivakkam, Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** Engineering / Medical Equipment Manufacturing

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer** to manage day-to-day machine shop operations while independently handling **CNC/VMC programming, machining processes, production planning, quality, and manpower supervision**.

The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **CNC/VMC machining, CNC programming, tool selection, cutting parameters, drawing interpretation, production planning, and shop-floor management**.

Key Responsibilities1. Machine Shop Supervision

* Supervise daily activities of the Machine Shop and ensure smooth production operations.
* Allocate jobs and manpower based on production priorities and machine availability.
* Monitor machine utilization, production output, cycle time, and productivity.
* Ensure jobs are completed within the planned production schedule.
* Coordinate with Production, Design, R&D, QC, Stores, Maintenance, and other departments.
* Maintain proper discipline, housekeeping, and 5S practices within the machine shop.
* Monitor machine condition and coordinate with Maintenance for breakdowns and preventive maintenance.

2. CNC / VMC Programming

* Prepare, modify, and optimize CNC/VMC programs based on engineering drawings and job requirements.
* Develop CNC programs using appropriate programming methods/software.
* Understand and work with **G-code and M-code**.
* Select suitable cutting tools, inserts, holders, and machining strategies.
* Set appropriate cutting speed, feed rate, depth of cut, spindle speed, and machining parameters.
* Optimize programs to reduce cycle time, tool wear, and machining cost.
* Prove out and validate new programs before production.
* Make necessary program corrections based on machining and inspection results.

3. Drawing & Technical Understanding

* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, and machining specifications.
* Understand material specifications such as MS, SS, Aluminium, EN-series materials, etc.
* Identify machining requirements and determine suitable processes.
* Coordinate with the Design/R&D team regarding drawing and machining-related issues.

4. Production Planning & Monitoring

* Prepare daily and weekly machine-shop production plans.
* Prioritize urgent and critical jobs.
* Monitor job progress against production targets.
* Track pending, running, completed, rejected, and rework jobs.
* Ensure proper machine loading and minimize machine idle time.
* Maintain production records and provide regular status reports to management.

5. Quality Control

* Ensure machining is carried out according to approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate with QC/Inspection teams for first-piece and final inspection.
* Identify dimensional and machining defects and take corrective action.
* Minimize rejection, rework, and material wastage.
* Ensure proper use of measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Bore Gauge, etc.

6. Tool & Material Management

* Monitor availability and usage of cutting tools, inserts, holders, coolant, and other consumables.
* Maintain proper tool inventory and usage records.
* Recommend suitable tooling to improve productivity and quality.
* Control tool consumption and avoid unnecessary wastage.

7. Manpower Management

* Supervise CNC/VMC operators, machinists, helpers, and other machine-shop personnel.
* Allocate operators according to machine and job requirements.
* Train and guide operators on machine operation, programming, safety, and quality requirements.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and work performance.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend training requirements.

8. Safety & Compliance

* Ensure all employees follow machine-shop safety procedures.
* Ensure proper use of PPE and safety equipment.
* Maintain safe working conditions around CNC/VMC and conventional machines.
* Ensure proper handling of tools, materials, chips, coolant, and finished components.
* Immediately report unsafe conditions, accidents, or machine-related hazards to management.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of **CNC / VMC machining operations**.
* CNC programming and program editing.
* Knowledge of **G-code and M-code**.
* Knowledge of cutting tools and machining parameters.
* Ability to read engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Knowledge of tooling selection and machining processes.
* Knowledge of CNC/VMC machine setting and offset correction.
* Understanding of production planning and shop-floor management.
* Knowledge of inspection and measuring instruments.
* Knowledge of 5S, productivity improvement, and rejection control.
* Basic knowledge of CAD/CAM software will be an added advantage.

Educational Qualification

* Diploma / ITI / BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or related discipline.
* Candidates with strong practical CNC/VMC machining experience may also be considered.

Experience

**5–10 years of relevant experience** in CNC/VMC machining and machine-shop supervision.

Experience in **engineering manufacturing, precision machining, medical equipment manufacturing, or similar industries** will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Production target achievement
* Machine utilization
* Reduction in machine idle time
* Reduction in rejection and rework
* CNC program accuracy
* Cycle-time improvement
* Tool consumption and cost control
* On-time completion of production schedules
* Quality compliance
* Manpower productivity
* Machine breakdown coordination
* 5S and shop-floor discipline

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong hands-on experience in CNC/VMC programming and machining.
* Good leadership and manpower-handling skills.
* Ability to independently handle machine-shop operations.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability.
* Ability to work under production pressure and meet deadlines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Responsible, disciplined, and safety-conscious.
* Willing to work hands-on with the production team when required.

Reporting To

**Production Manager / Operations Head / Management**

Working Location

**Wemake Solutions Pvt Ltd**  
**Thirumudivakkam, Chennai**

**MANAGER/SENIOR MANAGER – ENGINEERING**

**Department:** Engineering

**Reports to:** Director - Admin Operations

**About the Company:** Perfect Day is on a mission to create a kinder, greener tomorrow using precision fermentation. Leveraging expertise across biology, food innovation, and consumer products, Perfect Day empowers companies to develop, scale, and commercialize next-generation products that satisfy market demands and champion a path towards a more sustainable future.

**About the Department:** The Engineering Department supports site operations by maintaining the reliability, availability, safety, and efficiency of facility infrastructure, laboratory equipment, and utility systems. The team manages engineering projects, equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, and maintenance while ensuring compliance with applicable GLP, EHS, regulatory, and quality requirements.

**Corporate Services:** The Corporate Services Business Unit serves as the foundational infrastructure that enables the other three business units to drive Perfect Day's growth. These functions include Marketing, Communications, Finance, Legal, People & Culture, IT, Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Facilities, Lab Services, Capital and Strategic Projects.

**Position Summary:** The Manager/Senior Manager – Engineering is responsible for the effective management of engineering operations, including laboratory equipment, utilities, and facility infrastructure. The role leads maintenance and reliability activities, supports engineering projects and equipment lifecycle management, and ensures compliance with applicable GLP, EHS, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with R&D and cross-functional teams, the position enables safe, reliable, and efficient operations through sound engineering practices and continuous improvement.

**What You Will Do:**

·Coordinate equipment installation, commissioning, calibration, and qualification activities, including preparation and review of relevant documentation (URS, FAT, SAT, DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ).

·Ensure timely documentation and closure of deviations, change controls, risk assessments, and CAPAs; coordinate engineering responses to internal and external audit observations.

· Manage external vendors and service providers for preventive maintenance, calibration, repairs, and other engineering services; coordinate effectively with R&D and other departments to support site operations.

· Promote safe working practices, environmental compliance, sustainability, and good housekeeping across engineering and facility operations.

· Identify and implement opportunities for equipment reliability improvement, resource optimization, and operational efficiency.

**What You Bring:** We are looking for a technically strong and proactive engineering professional who can manage site engineering operations, work effectively with cross-functional teams, and drive reliable and compliant facility support.

**Education, Experience & Other Requirements:**

· Diploma / B.Tech / BE Mechanical/Electrical and Electronics Engineering.

· 10–14 years of relevant experience, preferably in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (Must Have):**

· Practical knowledge of the installation, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of biotechnology or pharmaceutical laboratory equipment and utility systems.

· Working knowledge of equipment qualification and commissioning processes, including URS, FAT, SAT, DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ.

· Knowledge of preventive, corrective, and reliability-based maintenance practices.

· Understanding of cleanroom requirements, applicable regulatory guidelines, and GLP/GMP documentation practices.

· Ability to review technical documents, maintenance records, qualification documents, and engineering procedures.

· Strong problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage vendors and service providers.

· Understanding of engineering key performance indicators (KPIs) and maintenance performance monitoring.

**Certifications, Licenses & Language Skills:** Fluency in Kannada and English, including reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Perfect Day is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Fermentation & Upstream Processing
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This position involves managing and optimizing upstream manufacturing operations, including microbial fermentation, media preparation, inoculum development, and microbial algae cultivation. The role focuses on overseeing day-to-day production activities, optimizing fermentation parameters, improving biomass productivity, and ensuring consistent batch performance while meeting production targets and quality standards. The candidate should have exposure to the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, from microbial algae, along with a strong understanding of fermentation processes, process optimization, and scale-up. The role also requires effective coordination with downstream processing, quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day upstream manufacturing operations, including media preparation, sterilization, inoculum development, fermentation, and microbial algae cultivation.
* Supervise and monitor fermentation processes to ensure consistent biomass growth, product yield, and adherence to production schedules.
* Operate and oversee fermenters, bioreactors, seed vessels, media preparation systems, sterilization systems, and associated auxiliary equipment.
* Support upstream production of microbial biomass for the manufacture of omega oils, including DHA and EPA, derived from microbial algae.
* Monitor and optimize critical process parameters such as temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, agitation, aeration, nutrient feed, and fermentation duration.
* Perform media optimization, inoculum optimization, and process parameter optimization based on strain performance and production requirements.
* Troubleshoot fermentation-related issues, identify root causes of process deviations, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure proper execution of batch manufacturing activities, including batch documentation, process monitoring, yield tracking, and timely batch completion.
* Take responsibility for the successful execution of assigned batches, ensuring process consistency, productivity, and compliance with established specifications.
* Support process development, technology transfer, and scale-up activities from laboratory or pilot scale to commercial manufacturing scale.
* Coordinate with downstream processing teams to ensure the timely transfer of fermentation broth or biomass for subsequent extraction and purification operations.
* Collaborate with quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to address process deviations, equipment breakdowns, and operational challenges.
* Ensure compliance with applicable GMP requirements, SOPs, safety protocols, hygiene standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate production records, batch manufacturing records, equipment logbooks, and other relevant documentation.
* Monitor raw material and media requirements, coordinate procurement planning with relevant departments, and minimize material wastage.
* Assist in production planning, manpower allocation, shift scheduling, and resource utilization to achieve manufacturing targets within the approved budget.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost reduction, increased biomass productivity, improved fermentation yields, and enhanced operational efficiency.
* Lead and guide upstream production personnel, ensuring adherence to operating procedures, safety practices, and quality standards.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new technologies, automation systems, and process improvements in upstream manufacturing.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.
* Duties and responsibilities are not limited to the work listed above and may include other assignments as necessary

Qualifications, Competencies, and Position Requirements

* Strong technical knowledge of upstream bioprocessing, microbial fermentation, and bioreactor operations.
* Practical understanding of microbial algae cultivation and fermentation-based production of omega oils, particularly DHA and/or EPA, is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of media formulation, inoculum development, sterilization, aseptic techniques, and fermentation process control.
* Ability to monitor, analyze, and optimize critical process parameters to improve biomass productivity and product yield.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting, root cause analysis, process deviation management, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Familiarity with GMP, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, and industrial safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple production activities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Willingness to work in shifts, including night shifts, as required.
* Willingness to travel as required by the role.

***Education and Experience:***

* M.Tech, M.Sc., or Ph.D. in Biotechnology.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant industrial experience in upstream manufacturing, microbial fermentation, or bioprocess operations, preferably in the nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, food biotechnology, or microbial oil industry.
* Hands-on experience in industrial-scale fermentation, bioreactor operations, media optimization, and process parameter optimization is preferred.
* Exposure to microbial algae cultivation and the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, is desirable.
* Knowledge of GMP requirements, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, process troubleshooting, and quality standards is preferred.

***Travel:***

* Ability to travel as required by role.

***Location:***

* Trivandrum and Bangalore

***Remuneration:***

* As per industry. Will consider higher for deserving candidates.

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

* **Compensation:** Consultant fee (fixed or monthly retainer or Project Based feedback ), to be discussed

jobs.title: NPD Manager – Nutraceuticals & Functional Foods
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad (in-office)

**Function:**
R&D & New Product Development

**Reports to:**
Founders

Earthful is a clean-label, plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures, and recently featured on Shark Tank India. Every product we sell starts as a brief written here. This role owns that journey from idea to a product on the shelf: the formulation, the trials, the evidence behind the claims, and the partners who make it.

**Role Overview**

You'll own new product development and improvement of existing products across supplements, functional foods, and wellness, working through contract manufacturers, third-party formulators, and ingredient vendors. You'll work directly with the founders on what to build, with Regulatory & Compliance on claims and labels, with Procurement on ingredients and packaging, and with Brand, Design, and Growth on launch. The job rewards people who can combine scientific judgment with speed, cost discipline, and follow-through.

**What You'll Own**

**Concept to Formulation Brief**

• Turn product concepts and consumer insight into clear, testable briefs for formulators and manufacturing partners

• Research ingredients, formats, and dosages for new wellness and supplement products

• Benchmark competitor products across India and global markets on formulation, claims, pricing, and positioning

• Develop across formats: powders, gummies, capsules, tablets, sachets, and others as the range grows

**Formulation & Product Trials**

• Own formulation development, from first sample to approved pilot batch

• Track every iteration — sensory trials, stability results, scale-up outcomes — and decide what moves forward and what is rejected

• Evaluate products on taste, mixability, texture, aroma, appearance, and usability

• Maintain structured documentation of trials, observations, and formulation changes

**Ingredient & Claims Research**

• Evaluate functional ingredients for dosage, evidence, usage restrictions, and clean-label suitability

• Build the claim substantiation file for each product — literature, references, and product rationale — before artwork is finalized

• Stay current on trends in women's health, gut health, protein, sleep and stress, and preventive wellness

**Vendor & Manufacturer Coordination**

• Coordinate with ingredient suppliers, contract manufacturers, and testing labs on samples, timelines, COAs, specifications, MOQs, and trial batches

• Support sourcing of ingredients and packaging components for new launches

• Compare vendors on quality, responsiveness, cost, and scalability, and give Procurement the technical input to negotiate

**Quality & Compliance Support**

• Own product specifications, ingredient sheets, and test reports for every product you develop

• Provide accurate label inputs, and work with Regulatory & Compliance on classification and claim alignment before launch

**Launch Readiness**

• Work with Brand, Design, Operations, and Growth so every product is ready on the launch date

• Translate technical product details into simple consumer-facing benefits

• Brief internal teams through launch decks, product notes, and FAQs

**Cost & Existing Product Improvement**

• Hold each formulation to a target cost of goods set at the brief stage, and flag early when a design choice puts it at risk

• Use consumer reviews, complaints, and operational feedback to prioritize improvements to existing products

• Use AI tools for literature and competitor research, verifying dosage, regulatory limits, and citations before anything is relied upon

• Education qualification - B Pharma, M Pharma, Pharmacognosy, Food technology

**What We're Looking For**

• 6–8 years of hands-on experience in NPD, R&D, or product development in supplements, nutraceuticals, functional foods, or FMCG wellness - who can independently lead the development activities.

• Brand-side experience: has taken products from brief to commercial launch through contract manufacturers or third-party formulators at a D2C or consumer brand — not only in-house at a manufacturer

• Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Nutrition, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related life-sciences field

• Working knowledge of FSSAI regulations for nutraceuticals and functional foods, and of claim substantiation

• Hands-on formulation experience in more than one format (powders, gummies, capsules, tablets, sachets)

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and disciplined documentation habits

• Consumer-first thinking and curiosity about what makes a product work in the market

• Comfortable in a fast-moving startup with high ownership and direct access to the founders

jobs.title: Formulation Analytical Development Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**JOB PURPOSE:**
Provide senior individual-contributor technical leadership for OTC formulation science, product design, development, scale-up, technology transfer, regulatory technical support, and lifecycle management across consumer healthcare products and dosage forms.
  
  
The Principal Scientist, OTC Formulation is a individual-contributor technical authority responsible for shaping formulation strategy and resolving complex technical challenges across OTC consumer healthcare development programs. The role reports to the Senior Principal Scientist, OTC Product Development / Formulation Science, and operates through technical depth, cross-functional influence, senior review, governance, and mentorship rather than direct line management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Formulation and Product Development
* Define formulation strategy and technical development approach for complex OTC products across relevant consumer healthcare categories.
* Translate consumer, commercial, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing requirements into robust target product profiles and formulation strategies.
* Provide senior technical leadership for dosage-form design, pre-formulation, excipient selection, active compatibility, product performance, and risk-based formulation decisions.
* Resolve complex formulation challenges including palatability, dose delivery, solubility, dissolution, rheology, microbial robustness, preservative effectiveness, packaging interaction, and stability.
* Embed QbD, design of experiments, critical quality attributes, critical process parameters, control strategy, and technical risk management into development programs.
* Technical Leadership and Delivery
* Ensure formulation decisions support consumer experience, labelled use, dose delivery, product performance, and OTC self-care suitability.
* Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Claims, Consumer Science, Commercial, Quality, Packaging, Supply, and external partners to support evidence readiness and product delivery.
* Provide technical review of formulation rationale, development data, stability conclusions, regulatory technical content, and lifecycle change assessments.
* Contribute to innovation, external technology assessment, competitive benchmarking, design-to-value, productivity, sustainability, and lifecycle improvement opportunities.

**Why you?**
**Basic Qualifications:**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* Master’s degree in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent senior technical experience may be considered.
* Typically 8-10+ years of formulation, product development, or technical leadership experience in OTC, consumer healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated product environments.
* Demonstrated accountability for formulation strategy, technical problem solving, and delivery of multiple products, platforms, dosage forms, or lifecycle programs.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, work with external partners, and coach or mentor scientists through technical authority rather than formal line-management authority.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Experience supporting multiple geographic markets, APAC regulatory environments, or OTC monograph/local-standard frameworks.
* Experience with pain, respiratory, allergy, gastrointestinal, dermatology, wellness, or adjacent self-care categories.
* Experience with contract development or manufacturing organizations, external laboratories, packaging partners, or external innovation partners.
* Knowledge of QbD, design of experiments, technical risk assessment, design-to-value, sustainability, and structured problem-solving tools.

**Core Competencies:**

* Strategic formulation leadership and advanced scientific judgment.
* Complex technical problem solving and risk-based decision making.
* Cross-functional influence and stakeholder management.
* Clear technical communication, documentation, and governance mindset.
* Knowledge sharing, and capability building as an individual contributor.
* Consumer-focused innovation, business acumen, and continuous improvement mindset.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Quality and impact of formulation strategy, technical direction, and risk-based decisions.
* Delivery of key technical milestones across development, scale-up, launch, and lifecycle programs.
* Robustness, stability, manufacturability, scalability, and consumer acceptability of developed products.
* Resolution of complex formulation, process, analytical, packaging, stability, and manufacturing issues.
* Quality of technical documentation, regulatory support, control strategy, and lifecycle change assessments.
* Contribution to innovation, productivity, sustainability, external technology assessment, and formulation-science capability building.

2026-12-25

It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people.
