jobs.title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager for Application Lab of Personal Care & Home Care
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Application Lab Senior Executive / Assistant Manager develops tests and demonstrates personal care and home care formulations that showcase the company's principals' ingredients. The role bridges suppliers, sales teams and customers, turning raw material know-how into practical formulations, technical data and compelling presentations.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Skin Care Formulations

* Develop and optimise skin care prototypes – creams, lotions, serums, gels, sun care, cleansers and colour cosmetic bases – using the principals' emulsifiers, emollients, actives, UV filters, rheology modifiers, preservatives and sensory additives.
* Create benchmark and starting-point formulations that showcase ingredient performance, stability and sensory.
* Adapt customer formulas for ingredient substitution, cost optimisation, sustainability or regulatory change.
* Work on natural, vegan and clean beauty concepts in line with market trends.

2. Hair Care Formulations

* Develop shampoos, conditioners, masks, leave-on treatments, styling products, colorants and scalp-care formulations.
* Evaluate surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones and alternatives, and actives for claims such as anti-dandruff, repair, frizz control and colour protection.
* Run sulphate-free, silicone-free and bio-based formulation projects.

3. Home Care Support

* Support home care formulations (laundry, dishwash, surface and fabric care) as business needs require.

4. Testing and Performance Evaluation

* Test physico-chemical parameters: pH, viscosity, appearance, colour, odour, foam, SPF/UV and droplet size.
* Run stability (accelerated, freeze-thaw, light, centrifuge), compatibility and preservative efficacy studies, coordinating with external labs where needed.
* Conduct sensory panels and in-vitro/in-vivo claim support studies, including hair-tress and skin-feel evaluations.
* Maintain and calibrate lab instruments; ensure GLP, safety and housekeeping.

5. Innovation and Trend Monitoring

* Track global personal care trends, launches, regulations and competitor products; convert insights into concept formulations.
* Collaborate with principals on new ingredient launches and co-development projects.
* Propose new product concepts and sustainable, value-added solutions for the regional market.
* Capture market and consumer trends from market visits, customers, retail and competitor products; share insights and opportunity reports with sales, marketing and principals.

6. Trade Shows, Events and Customer Engagement

* Prepare and present formulations, samples and demo material at trade shows and conferences (e.g., in-cosmetics, HPCI, CHT, local exhibitions).
* Support technical seminars, lab tours and live application demonstrations.
* Support the sales team on customer visits, in person and virtual (video calls, online demos, webinars), with technical inputs, formulation discussions and follow-up.
* Join sales on market visits to brand owners, contract manufacturers and trade partners to understand requirements and opportunities.
* Provide technical troubleshooting to customers on formulation, stability, processing and performance issues – identify root causes and recommend corrective solutions.

7. Documentation

* Maintain accurate lab notebooks, formulation records, batch sheets and test reports.
* Prepare technical data sheets, formulation brochures, application notes and product dossiers with full traceability.
* Support sales and principals with technical documents, test data, certificates and customer queries.
* Support regulatory and compliance documentation (SDS, claims support, BIS, ISO 22716/GMP).
* Support sampling: prepare, label, pack and dispatch samples; track requests, feedback and conversions.
* Manage the formulation database, sample inventory and retention-sample library.

8. Presentations and Technical Communication

* Deliver technical presentations to customers, internal teams and principals, covering formulation results and project updates.
* Present case studies and performance data with clear visuals.
* Develop product application training for sales teams.
* Work with marketing on digital campaigns (webinars, e-mailers, social media, online content) and promotional material (brochures, flyers, application videos, case studies), ensuring technical accuracy.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* M.Sc / B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Pharm / M.Pharm in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Oils & Surfactants, Chemical or Pharmaceutical Technology.

**Experience**

* Senior Executive: 3–6 years; Assistant Manager: 6–10 years in personal care formulation (skin and hair care), in a lab, application or R&D role – preferably with a raw material supplier or distributor.
* Hands-on experience in emulsions, surfactant systems, sun care and hair care.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of cosmetic ingredients, INCI, stability and regulatory basics.
* Excellent presentation, communication and customer-facing skills.
* Proficient in MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel; formulation software is a plus.
* Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Collaborative, curious and innovative; willing to travel for trade shows and customer visits.

Works closely with Personal Care and Home Care sales and marketing, principals' technical teams, customers, and regulatory and quality functions.

jobs.title: Head PreClinical- Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology
jobs.description:
VENUS MEDICINE RESEARCH CENTRE (VMRC)

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

Regulatory & GLP

* Lead nonclinical regulatory submissions:
* CTD Modules 2.4, 2.6, 4
* FDA, EMA, CDSCO submissions
* Drive GLP compliance, SOP quality, QA readiness, and facility accreditation
* Support publications, scientific presentations, and regulatory interactions

Regulatory Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

Strong working knowledge of:

* OECD GLP Principles
* ICH M3(R2), S-series, E6(R2)
* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Proven anti-infective or antimicrobial development experience
* Exposure to BL+BLI or combination products
* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing preclinical teams and infrastructure

jobs.company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water
jobs.description:
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!

**At CEEW, we build careers in public policy**

* We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale
* We actively promote leadership by initiative
* We celebrate talent and ambition
* You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow
* You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations
* Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility, come together at CEEW
* You will get above-market remuneration
* We provide a safe space for all
* At CEEW, your life is your example for others

**Designation offered**
  
Senior Programme Lead

**Reporting to**
  
Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)

**Location**
  
New Delhi, India

### **Purpose**

Systems change in food systems reform is impeded by entrenched political economy dynamics. We are looking for a leader who can not only navigate this political economy, but also orchestrate difficult, real change – rewriting political economy equations and enabling systemic transformation. They will build and lead a team working at the interface of political economy, public policy, and institutions, and will advance the Council’s research, policy engagement, and impact by helping the programme understand and navigate political economy while actively orchestrating systems-level change in India’s food systems.

### **Responsibilities and Duties**

**Strategy**

* Co-evolve the strategy for the programme’s political economy work, building on existing in-house thinking, the political economy landscape across food systems reform, our skillset and niche, the evolving sectoral narrative, and emerging government priorities.
* Work closely with the team to bring alignment within the team on the strategy.
* Build a network of contacts across government, political leadership, and public institutions to create sustained pathways for policy and institutional change.
* Spearhead coalition building with public institutions, political leadership, and civil society partners, in coordination with internal project streams, creating a high-leverage venue for catalytic action on political economy transitions.
* Lead the thinking on how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making in food systems; scope and develop new ideas and programmes to shift this political economy towards sustainability transitions.

### **Research**

* Lead research and intelligence-gathering on the political economy of food systems reform, including the role of institutions, regulatory environments, incentives, and narratives in shaping decision-making.
* Develop intelligence and strategies to shape the political economy of food systems towards sustainability transitions, and identify levers and entry points for orchestrating change.
* Map stakeholders, interests, and power structures across government, political leadership, and public institutions relevant to food systems reform, ensuring alignment and collaborative execution.
* Lead research in the programme area as a principal investigator. Guide and provide relevant inputs to the wider research agenda.
* Assess and improve existing methodologies and frameworks employed by SFS relevant to political economy analysis, and build institutional capacity on such methodologies.
* Keep a tab on policy and political developments in agriculture and food systems.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to write coherently and concisely: emails, opinion pieces, policy briefs, and reports

### **Leadership and Mentoring**

* Take end-to-end ownership of the programme. Ideate new research concepts with team members, develop project proposals and budgets, build relationships with donors that align with the institution’s interests, secure resources for building and expanding the work programme, deliver high-quality, timely outputs, engage with sectoral stakeholders, strive for impact, and develop CEEW’s thought leadership.
* Build and lead your team. Hone the team members to the best of their abilities. Stretch and strive and set leadership by initiative.
* Lead the strategic outreach of the programme. Lead external meetings, conferences, and seminars with government, political leadership, and public institutions, and be the face of CEEW in your programme area, while also creating platforms for your team for public engagement.
* Strategise the communication and outreach of research outputs along with the outreach team.
* Build strong relationships based on trust and credibility with key policymakers, political leadership, and sector stakeholders.

### **Selection Criteria and Key Skills**

* **Education:** PhD or Master’s degree in public policy/political science/international relations/ agriculture/rural development/food systems/public affairs/mass communication/journalism or any other relevant field relevant to food systems transformation.

### **Professional experience**

* At least 10 years of relevant experience in undertaking and leading research, policy engagement, and project management, in one or more of the following areas. Candidates who have prior experience in the following fields will be given a strong preference:
  + Political economy and public policy
  + Working in or with governments, political leadership, or public institutions
  + Agriculture, rural development, or food systems
  + Public affairs, strategic communications, or journalism, with an understanding of how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making
* Ability to navigate diverse stakeholders and strategise systems-level change
* Proven track record in building relationships and coalitions with government, political leadership, and public institutions
* Experience in designing and leading interdisciplinary and inter-programmatic work
* Strong track record of team management and project management, including timely delivery of outputs
* Have demonstrated thought leadership in the areas relevant to the ToR

### **Skills and Competencies**

* Curiosity and an ability to think creatively.
* Willingness to learn new research and project management skills.
* Willingness to travel for field visits and stakeholder interviews (if needed).
* Ability to effectively work in a team while driving research with minimum assistance, when time demands independently.
* Ability to adapt to a new environment and deliver under tight deadlines in a professional environment.
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output.
* Ability to dig deeper into details, while also keeping a sense of the broader objectives and big picture.

### **Compensation**

Competitive compensation – commensurate to the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by the industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

### **Application process**

CEEW is an equal opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate on the basis of age, gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by us. We appreciate your interest.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

As a world market leader in crop protection, we help farmers to counter these threats and ensure enough safe, nutritious, affordable food for all – while minimizing the use of land and other agricultural inputs.

Syngenta Crop Protection keeps plants safe from planting to harvesting. From the moment a seed is planted through to harvest, crops need to be protected from weeds, insects and diseases as well as droughts and floods, heat and cold.

Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Switzerland.

 **Job Description**

**ROLE PURPOSE**

**To support the strategic direction and achievement of business objectives of Syngenta in India, enhancing freedom to operate through building and maintaining Syngenta’s reputation externally.**

* To support the strategic direction and achievement of Syngenta’s business objectives in India by enhancing its freedom to operate, strengthening external reputation, and driving effective corporate affairs, government relations and public policy engagement.
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in developing and implementing the regional Corporate Affairs strategy, translating regional priorities into India-specific action plans and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
* Develop and implement an India Corporate Affairs action plan in consultation with the Head of Corporate Affairs to support business objectives, ensure consistent engagement with key stakeholders, and strengthen Syngenta’s reputation in India.
* Work with business leaders and commercial unit heads to implement local and regional programs, ensuring disciplined and consistent internal and external communications, systematic stakeholder mapping, and effective stakeholder engagement.'

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Reputation Management, Governmental and Public Affairs**

* Develop a Corporate Affairs & Reputation Management action plan for India that supports the delivery of the regional corporate affairs strategy, and which is specific to the circumstances, issues and stakeholders in India. The approach should identify key stakeholders (government, research institutes, NGOs, media, investors, academics etc) and their influencers across the region and form the basis for detailed action and engagement plans.
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in developing and implementing regional Corporate Affairs strategies, priorities and programs, ensuring effective execution in India and alignment with regional objectives, business priorities and global reputation management frameworks.
* Support external communications and media relations in India in collaboration with appointed PR agencies, including communication planning, media engagement, press releases, media briefings and other external communication materials, ensuring consistency with Syngenta’s corporate positioning and messaging.
* Deliver pro-active reputation management (identification, informing, educating and influencing), particularly with key government stakeholders relevant issues (e.g. technology acceptance, public private partnerships and collaborations, regulatory policy and implementation in concert with regulatory affairs through a “License to Operate” environment) with disciplined and consistent stakeholder management activities including the use of direct engagement and the full array of communication and influence channels – media, public forums, industry groups, speeches and keynotes etc.
* Maintain regular dialogue on key issues with key government, industry and NGO contacts to ensure Syngenta’s position on key issues and our contribution to the management of these issues is well understood and accepted. Ensuring wherever possible the alignment between stakeholder objectives and Syngenta’s own objectives.
* Lead and manage relationships with key State Agriculture stakeholders, including State Agriculture Departments, Agricultural Universities, Research Institutions, and state-level industry bodies, to support business priorities, policy advocacy, and stakeholder engagement objectives.
* Contributes to strengthening the organization’s technical knowledge of the regulatory and policy environment by effectively engaging with government ministries and regulatory authorities, while applying strong technical expertise to interpret and navigate registration requirements, processes, and compliance nuances.
* Responsible for securing and maintaining the License to Operate (LTO) and License to Produce (LPO) for the SIPL portfolio, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, regulatory compliance, and business continuity.
* Work with Regulatory Affairs managers to ensure a smooth transfer of existing government networks and contacts
* Provide inputs to the annual cycle of events associated with global reputation management, including inputs to the Annual Report, position papers, media releases and general events as they relate to South Asia
* Track Syngenta’s reputation across South Asia identifying key metrics and drivers and then establishing issues, themes and possible response strategies
* Ensure a consistent approach to reputation management through adoption of best practice common procedures and tools and sharing of best practices within business units

**Public Policy / Public Relations**

* Partners with non-government think tanks, state industry bodies, farmer networks, and NGOs to advance policy advocacy and reputation management objectives.

**Crisis Communications - EMS**

* Working with the Regional EMS Team, develop crisis communications plan as necessary to support corporate reputation in India

 **Qualifications**

**Critical Knowledge & Experience:**

* 15+ years of experience in Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Public Policy, or Reputation Management within a multinational organization (agriculture, biotech, or allied sectors preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, Public Policy, Law, Business Administration, or a related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Strong understanding of the Indian agriculture sector, regulatory landscape, and public policy environment.

**Key Deliverables**

jobs.title: ISO 22000 Auditor
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
“At QIMA, you feel like you belong from Day 1. You join a community of smart minds who not only innovate, but also support and inspire each other. Here, we own our work, have fun together, and make everyday count.”
  
  
The QIMA and EFRAC Story
  
  
At QIMA, our Food Division is dedicated to helping every member of the global food supply chain ensure the safety and quality of food products, as well as safe working conditions and sustainable practices. With inspections, audits and certifications, we support food growers, producers and retailers, as well as businesses in food service and hospitality, securing their food products' journey from farm to shelf and fork.
  
  
Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
  
  
EFRAC, part of QIMA group is a laboratory testing services company focusing on food safety, pharmaceutical quality control, and environmental monitoring.
  
  
What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
  
  
**Job Description**
The Role in Brief
  
  
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ISO 22000 Auditor to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting audits of food safety management systems in accordance with ISO 22000 standards. This role requires a comprehensive understanding of food safety principles, risk management, and the ability to assess compliance effectively.
  
  
**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include**

* Perform comprehensive audits of food safety management systems (FSMS) in accordance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Assess documentation, including food safety policies, procedures, and records, to ensure compliance with ISO requirements.
* Analyze the effectiveness of the FSMS, including hazard analysis and critical control points (HACCP), to identify potential risks.
* Detect areas of non-compliance or weaknesses in the FSMS and provide recommendations for corrective actions.
* If applicable, oversee the collection of samples for testing to verify compliance with safety standards.
* Prepare detailed audit reports summarizing findings, observations, and recommendations for improvements.

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Develop and implement audit plans for ISO 22000 compliance.
* Conduct thorough audits of food safety management systems, assessing processes, procedures, and documentation.
* Prepare detailed audit reports that highlight findings, non-conformities, and areas for improvement.
* Maintain accurate and organized records of all audit activities and compliance assessments.
* Collaborate with food business operators and staff to enhance understanding of ISO 22000 standards.
* Provide recommendations and support for corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay informed about industry trends and changes in regulations to ensure compliance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Recommend enhancements to audit processes and tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Engage in ongoing professional education to remain current with ISO standards and food safety practices.
* Attend relevant workshops, training sessions, and industry conferences.

Profile Requirements
  
  
**To Succeed In This Role, You Have**

* A food-related or bioscience degree (minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent) OR Atleast a successfully completed food-related professional higher education.
* At least 2 years of work experience in food industry
* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.
* HACCP course (minimum 16 hours) recognized by the International HACCP Alliance; and ISO 22000:2018 course (minimum of 16 hours) + Lead Auditor course (on QMS) of 40 hours of duration including the exam. OR Lead Auditor Course (FSMS (ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000) of 40 hours of duration including the exam.
* Minimum: 20 days as auditor of Quality Management Systems, Food Safety Management Systems or other Food Safety Standards (i.e. GFSI).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Qualifications**
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.
* HACCP course (minimum 16 hours) recognized by the International HACCP Alliance; and ISO 22000:2018 course (minimum of 16 hours) + Lead Auditor course (on QMS) of 40 hours of duration including the exam. OR Lead Auditor Course (FSMS (ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000) of 40 hours of duration including the exam.
* Minimum: 20 days as auditor of Quality Management Systems, Food Safety Management Systems or other Food Safety Standards (i.e. GFSI).

If you possess the skills and experience required for this role and are passionate about driving business growth in the food industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as our Regional Sales Manager.

**Critical Skills**

Attention to detail; ability to find win-win solutions; ability to serve as a conduit in the flow of information between communications team and business units; flexibility in a fast-paced organization; ability to frequently measure the effectiveness of ongoing programs and adapt accordingly.

Job Title: Quality Analyst – Food, Dairy & Sweets Manufacturing

**Company:** Bikanervala  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Department:** Quality Assurance / Quality Control  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Industry:** Food Processing, Dairy Products, Sweets & Confectionery

Job Summary

Bikanervala is looking for a dedicated and experienced Quality Analyst with practical knowledge of food quality control, dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety, hygiene, process control and regulatory compliance across food production and processing operations.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in dairy products, khoya/mawa, paneer, ghee, milk-based sweets and traditional Indian sweets, along with knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000 standards.

Key Responsibilities1. Raw Material Quality Inspection

* Inspect incoming raw materials such as milk, cream, khoya, paneer, ghee, sugar, flour, besan, dry fruits, edible oils and other food ingredients.
* Check raw material quality, freshness, specifications and supplier COAs.
* Conduct physical, chemical and sensory inspections.
* Monitor milk quality parameters, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Identify and segregate rejected or non-conforming raw materials.
* Maintain incoming material inspection records.

2. In-Process Quality Control – Dairy Products

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of milk, paneer, curd, yoghurt, ghee, butter, khoa and other dairy products.
* Monitor pasteurisation temperature and holding time.
* Check milk fat, SNF, acidity, pH and moisture.
* Monitor coagulation, fermentation, cooling and processing parameters.
* Ensure product consistency, texture, colour and taste.
* Monitor chilling, cold storage and hygienic handling practices.

3. In-Process Quality Control – Indian Sweets

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of Rasgulla, Rasmalai, Gulab Jamun, Kaju Katli, Barfi, Peda, Kalakand, Milk Cake, Besan Laddu, Motichoor Laddu and other traditional sweets.
* Monitor sugar syrup concentration using a refractometer (Brix).
* Check cooking temperature and processing time.
* Monitor moisture, texture, colour, taste and consistency.
* Check frying temperature and frying oil quality.
* Ensure uniformity in product size, weight, shape and appearance.
* Monitor cooling, handling and storage conditions.

4. Finished Product Quality Inspection

* Conduct final quality inspections before product release.
* Perform sensory evaluation for appearance, colour, taste, aroma and texture.
* Check product weight, moisture, pH, acidity, fat and Brix wherever applicable.
* Verify packaging quality, sealing and product labelling.
* Monitor batch number, manufacturing date and expiry date.
* Coordinate microbiological testing.
* Ensure finished products meet approved quality specifications.

5. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations and applicable food safety requirements.
* Monitor personal hygiene and food handling practices of production employees.
* Conduct regular production-floor hygiene inspections.
* Ensure proper cleaning and sanitation of equipment, utensils, processing areas and machinery.
* Monitor pest control, waste disposal and water quality.
* Prevent cross-contamination and allergen contamination.
* Verify cleaning and sanitation records.

6. Food Safety Management Systems

* Implement and monitor HACCP-based food safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GHP and SSOP.
* Support implementation and maintenance of ISO 22000 standards.
* Identify potential biological, chemical and physical hazards.
* Monitor Critical Control Points (CCPs) and applicable OPRPs.
* Maintain food safety monitoring and verification records.
* Ensure calibration of laboratory and quality inspection instruments.

7. Laboratory Testing & Analysis

* Perform routine physical and chemical testing of raw materials and finished products.
* Conduct milk testing for fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Perform moisture, pH, acidity and Brix analysis.
* Monitor frying oil quality and deterioration.
* Coordinate microbiological testing, including total plate count, yeast and mould, coliforms and other applicable parameters.
* Maintain laboratory records and test reports.
* Coordinate external laboratory testing when required.

8. Quality Audits & Documentation

* Conduct daily quality inspections and internal hygiene audits.
* Identify non-conformities and process deviations.
* Perform root cause analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone techniques.
* Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Maintain raw material inspection reports, production quality records, CCP monitoring sheets, laboratory reports, cleaning records and audit documentation.
* Support internal, external, FSSAI and customer audits.
* Maintain product traceability and recall-related records.

9. Coordination with Production & Operations

* Coordinate with production teams to maintain consistent product quality.
* Identify and resolve quality issues during manufacturing.
* Communicate deviations and recommend corrective measures.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse and operations teams.
* Monitor customer complaints, product rejections and quality improvement activities.
* Conduct food safety and hygiene awareness training for production employees.

Required Skills & Technical Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations and food safety standards.
* Practical knowledge of dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience in HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000.
* Knowledge of milk testing, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Knowledge of khoya/mawa quality testing and moisture analysis.
* Experience in Brix testing using a refractometer.
* Knowledge of frying oil quality monitoring.
* Understanding of microbiological testing and shelf-life evaluation.
* Knowledge of CAPA, root cause analysis and internal quality audits.

* Strong documentation and reporting abilities.

Important Practical Skills Required

Candidates with hands-on experience in the following areas will be preferred:

Experience Required

Food Safety & Production Supervisor

**Company:** Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt Ltd **Location:** Velachery Central Kitchen, Chennai **Reports to:** Head of Operations **Type:** Full-time, on-site (factory-based, with periodic store visits) **Apply to:** jobs@amadora.in

About Amadora

Amadora makes premium artisanal ice cream, baked goods, sauces, bars and cakes from scratch — no premixes, no compounds. Everything is produced at our central kitchen in Chennai on Pastomaster and Carpigiani equipment and distributed to franchise and company-owned stores across Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. As we scale, the discipline of the factory floor is what protects the brand.

The Role

We are looking for a food technologist who has worked as a Food Safety Executive and is ready to own both sides of the floor: making sure production runs the way the process says it should, and making sure food safety norms are followed without exception, every single day.

This is a hands-on shop-floor role, not a desk role. You will be present during production, checking that steps are followed as written, catching deviations while they are still small, and holding the line on hygiene, traceability and equipment condition. Alongside the daily work, you will drive our ISO certification programme and partner with the Training team to take food safety standards out to the stores.

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily production supervision

* Verify that every batch is produced to the approved recipe, sequence, temperature and time parameters — pasteurisation, ageing, batch freezing, blast freezing, hardening and packing.
* Run and sign off start-of-shift, in-process and end-of-shift checks; ensure line clearance between batches and between allergen and non-allergen runs.
* Check equipment and tooling condition before use — moulds, scoops, containers, gaskets, blades — and enforce immediate quarantine and physical removal of any damaged, chipped or worn item from the production area.
* Monitor CCPs and record readings in real time; escalate deviations immediately rather than at end of day.
* Verify raw material and packaging at receipt (COA, temperature, condition, shelf life) and enforce FEFO in cold rooms and dry stores.
* Support the production plan — yields, batch sizing, changeover time, wastage — and flag where process adherence and output targets are in conflict.

2. Food safety and hygiene compliance

* Own day-to-day implementation of HACCP, GMP and GHP across the facility.
* Manage personal hygiene, health checks, gowning and handwashing compliance for all production staff.
* Schedule and verify cleaning and sanitation (CIP and manual), pest control, water testing, swab testing and calibration; maintain the records.
* Run the foreign-material control programme: metal, glass, hard plastic, wood and mould-fragment controls, with defined inspection and breakage procedures.
* Manage the finished-goods and shelf-life testing programme, micro sampling and third-party lab coordination.
* Maintain FSSAI licence conditions and Schedule 4 compliance; be the point person for FSSAI and customer audits.
* Investigate customer complaints and internal non-conformances to root cause, define CAPA, and verify that the corrective action actually holds a month later.
* Maintain full batch traceability and be able to run a mock recall to closure.

3. ISO / FSSC certification

* Lead preparation for ISO 22000:2018 (and FSSC 22000 where applicable) — gap assessment, documentation, PRPs, HACCP plan, internal audits, management review and closure of certification body findings.
* Build and maintain the food safety management system documentation: manual, procedures, formats, records.
* Train and hand-hold the production team through the changes the certification requires, so the system survives after the certificate is issued.

4. Store food safety, with the Training team

* Work with the Head of Training to convert factory food safety standards into simple, teachable store-level procedures — cold chain, thawing, display, scooping hygiene, cleaning schedules, expiry management, allergen handling.
* Co-create training content, checklists and audit formats for franchise and company-owned stores.
* Conduct periodic store food safety audits, score them, and drive closure of findings with the operations and training teams.
* Support franchisee-side FSSAI compliance and readiness for regulatory inspections.

5. Documentation and reporting

* Maintain daily, weekly and monthly food safety and production compliance dashboards.
* Report non-conformances, wastage, complaint trends and audit scores to management with clear cause and action.

Qualifications and Competencies

**Required**

* B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Sc / M.Sc in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience, including a proven stint as a Food Safety Executive or Officer in a food manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of HACCP, GMP, GHP, FSSAI regulations and Schedule 4.
* Experience preparing for or maintaining ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 certification.
* Comfortable with documentation and record discipline — you can build a format, and you can also make people fill it correctly.
* Physically comfortable working in a cold-chain environment, including chillers and blast freezers, and around early production shifts.

**Preferred**

* Dairy, frozen dessert, bakery or chocolate manufacturing background.
* Certified HACCP Level 3 / ISO 22000 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor.
* Multi-site or retail-outlet audit exposure.
* Working Tamil and English; Kannada or Telugu a bonus given our other markets.

**Competencies we care about**

* Willingness to stop a batch. The right answer is sometimes expensive, and we want someone who says it anyway.
* Firm without being adversarial — you will be enforcing standards on colleagues you work beside every day.
* Bias for root cause over blame; interest in why the process allowed the mistake, not just who made it.
* Attention to detail that holds up on day 200, not just day 20.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

* **Month 1–3:** You have mapped every production line end to end, documented the actual process against the written SOP, and produced a prioritised gap list covering process adherence, hygiene, equipment condition and record-keeping.
* **Month 3–4:** Daily production and food safety checks are running consistently across all shifts, with real-time recording and same-day escalation of deviations — verified by you, not self-reported.
* **Month 6:** The ISO 22000 documentation set is complete, PRPs and the HACCP plan are implemented, and the first full internal audit cycle has been completed with CAPAs closed.
* **Month 6–9:** A store food safety standard, training module and audit checklist are live with the Training team, and the first round of audits is complete across Chennai stores.
* **Month 9–12:** ISO certification audit cleared, with no major non-conformances outstanding.
* **Through the year:** A measurable fall in food-safety-related customer complaints and internal non-conformances, with a traceability and mock-recall capability that closes within the target window.

Why Amadora

You will be the person who owns food safety at a brand that makes everything from scratch — which means real process, real risk and real ownership, not a premix line where the standards were set by someone else. You will build the system, certify it, and take it out to every store. Direct access to the founder and the leadership team, and a company growing fast enough that what you build now becomes how it operates at three times the size.

* Provident Fund

jobs.title: Product Manager – Nutraceuticals Division
jobs.description:
About Vieroots

Vieroots is a pioneering health-tech and wellness company specializing in personalized, genomics-driven preventive healthcare. By combining epigenetic lifestyle modifications (EPLIMO) with targeted nutritional supplementation, we empower individuals to optimize their healthspan and prevent lifestyle diseases. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, end-to-end Product Manager to spearhead the entire product lifecycle for our Nutraceuticals Division.

Role Overview

The Product Manager – Nutraceuticals will own the vision, strategy, formulation roadmap, launch, and lifecycle management of Vieroots’ nutritional supplement portfolio. You will act as the central bridge between our scientific/genomics team, R&D partners, regulatory affairs, supply chain, and marketing/sales teams—taking concepts from scientific insight to commercially successful, high-efficacy products.

Key Responsibilities

\* Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the multi-year product roadmap for the nutraceuticals division, aligning product launches with Vieroots’ personalized genomics and epigenetic recommendations.

\* End-to-End Product Development: Lead the full product development lifecycle (NPD)—from ideation, market research, and ingredient sourcing to formulation, stability testing, packaging design, and commercial scale-up.

\* Scientific & R&D Collaboration: Partner closely with in-house geneticists, nutritionists, and external R&D labs/contract manufacturers (CDMOs) to develop evidence-based, bioavailable, and differentiated formulations.

\* Regulatory & Quality Compliance: Ensure all formulations, claims, labels, and manufacturing processes strictly comply with FSSAI guidelines and relevant international nutraceutical standards (e.g., GMP, ISO, USFDA norms where applicable).

\* Vendor & Supply Chain Coordination: Identify, evaluate, and onboard contract manufacturers and raw ingredient suppliers; oversee cost optimization, COGS management, and vendor quality audits.

\* Go-To-Market (GTM) & Positioning: Craft compelling product positioning, value propositions, and scientific dossiers; collaborate with marketing, digital, and sales teams to drive product launches, medical/practitioner education, and customer adoption.

\* Lifecycle & P&L Management: Monitor post-launch performance, customer feedback, clinical efficacy data, and unit economics; drive product iterations, line extensions, and SKU rationalization.

Qualifications & Experience

\* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Food Technology, Biotechnology, Nutrition, Life Sciences, or a related field. An MBA in Product Management or Marketing is a strong plus.

\* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in product management, new product development (NPD), or brand management within the nutraceutical, dietary supplements, functional foods, or consumer healthcare/pharma industries.

\* Domain Expertise: Proven track record of taking nutraceutical or OTC health products from concept to market launch. Deep familiarity with FSSAI nutraceutical regulations, ingredient bioavailability, and formulation challenges.

\* Analytical & Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of pricing strategy, COGS, margin optimization, and market trend analysis.

\* Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional leadership, project management, and communication skills—capable of translating complex scientific/genomic concepts into clear consumer benefits.

Preferred Qualifications

\* Prior experience working in personalized nutrition, preventative healthcare, or direct-to-consumer (D2C) wellness brands.

\* Familiarity with nutrigenomics, epigenetics, or metabolic health supplements.

What We Offer

\* Opportunity to shape the product portfolio of a fast-growing, science-first personalized wellness brand.

\* High autonomy and end-to-end ownership across R&D, operations, and commercial strategy.

\* Collaborative, innovation-driven work culture with competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

* Salary Range is - 45000.00 - 70000.00

**Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha. 100% on-site, not remote and not hybrid.**

**Working hours: 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM IST (fixed shift).**
The company is based in Texas, USA, so the shift overlaps with US working hours.

***I'm a recruitment partner hiring for a client.***

**About the company**

Our client is a US-based AI startup headquartered in Texas, with its product and engineering team in Bhubaneswar. They build AI agents for restaurants, and every agent has one job: help restaurants grow revenue or cut costs.

**The company recently raised multi-million-dollar funding from a US investor.**
The new money is going into building more AI agents and growing the team, and this role sits at the center of that.

Their first AI agent is live with paying US restaurant customers. It handles a part of the business restaurants usually don't have time for, replying to customers in minutes, sending quotes, following up, and turning one-time orders into repeat business, all from the owner's phone. It has already delivered real revenue for customers.

**Next on the roadmap**
are AI agents for delivery platforms, food costing, margin recovery, prep forecasting and winning back lost customers. Several are already being tested inside working restaurants.

The restaurant industry is one of the largest in the US but has very little software that actually adds money to an owner's bottom line. That's the gap this company is building for.

**The role**

As Product Manager, you'll take these next AI agents from idea to live product, working directly with the founders and the founding engineer.

**What you'll do**

* Talk to US restaurant owners and managers to understand their real problems.
* Write clear specs for AI agents: what they do alone and where a human stays in the loop.
* Work daily with the founding engineer and ship every week.
* Run pilots with real customers and turn the learnings into v1.
* Share learnings with the founders in writing: what worked, what was killed, and why?

**Must-have**

* 2 to 5 years in product management.
* At least one product taken from idea to live users (side projects count if real people used them).
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including evals, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design.
* Comfortable with messy data such as spreadsheets and exports; can find the answer without needing clean data.
* Strong written communication.
* Based in Bhubaneswar or ready to relocate.
* Comfortable working a fixed 3 PM to 12 AM IST shift.

**Good to have**

* Experience at an early-stage startup.
* Background in B2B SaaS, restaurant tech, food tech or POS/delivery platforms.
* Experience running pilots or beta programs with paying customers.
* Ability to back every number on your resume (baseline, time frame, what you owned).

**Why join**

* Work directly with the founders, with no layers in between.
* **Freshly funded, with the new money going into building the products you'll own.**
* Paying customers already, so you're not building on a promise.
* Fast decisions, weekly launches, and real ownership of what ships.
* Competitive pay

**To apply:**
DM me or send your resume to gurleen@ratch.ai . Tell us the best thing you've shipped, and what you had to drop to ship it.

This position involves developing innovative food and beverage products with a specific focus on food formulation and microencapsulation technologies. jobs.title: Brand Manager - Europe
jobs.description:
**NULO IS:**

We are the fastest-growing U.S. pet food specialty brand and have recently begun our European expansion with major retail listings across Italy, Spain and the UK. We were named “Top 25 Most Innovative Consumer Brands” by Forbes Magazine, offering industry-leading dog and cat food products with a world-class sales team, in a multi-billion-dollar industry that’s ripe for innovation and change. Imagine inspiring pet parents to think differently about the experience of feeding their dogs and cats, to feed them like the little athletes they are - with foods high in meat protein, low in carbs and infused with viable probiotics. To learn more visit www.nulo.co.uk

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels
* **Build & Optimise the Nulo Demand Generation Engine –** working with the wider marketing team, develop and own a full-funnel demand generation programme that drives brand awareness, consideration and trial to recruit consumers at scale
* **Develop Consumer & Category Insight** - build a deep understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitors and emerging trends, converting insight into clear actions for the brand and portfolio.
* **Drive Brand Health & Performance** - track brand, category and commercial performance across priority markets, identifying growth opportunities and actions to improve awareness, consideration and trial, driving brand penetration and equity.
* **Shape Local Brand Positioning** - act as a guardian of Nulo’s positioning, distinctive assets and brand codes, ensuring global consistency is combined with local relevance
* **Portfolio Strategy & Innovation** - Lead on product lifecycle including performance analysis, opportunity identification, working with global teams on innovation and renovation
* **Lead Integrated Brand Campaign Development** - work with local & global teams and agency partners to develop and execute local campaigns.
* **360 Customer Planning** – lead development and execution of joint customer marketing plans.
* **Support Pricing & Portfolio Architecture** - partner with Commercial and Finance to inform pricing, pack architecture, promotional strategy and portfolio choices that support brand equity and profitable growth.
* **Brand P&L management** - manage and report on full brand P&L including managing brand investment, setting priorities and evaluating activity effectiveness
* **Agency & Partner Management** - lead relevant agency and specialist partner relationships, setting clear briefs and ensuring high-quality, on-brand delivery against timings and budgets.
* **Cross-functional Brand Leadership** - act as a key connector across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Global Teams to align priorities and deliver key initiatives

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, food, pet, or a related consumer-goods sector.
* Strong experience developing annual brand plans and translating consumer and commercial insight into clear growth strategies.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using consumer, category and commercial data to identify opportunities and measure performance.
* Commercial mindset with an understanding of pricing, promotional strategy, portfolio architecture and brand P&L drivers.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns and working across the full funnel
* Demonstrable experience working with key customers including joint business planning and shopper activations.
* Strong agency and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for others.
* Budget management experience and a strong focus on investment effectiveness.
* Fluent English and Spanish.

**Desirable Experience & Skills**

* Experience working across multiple European markets.
* Experience managing a portfolio, including innovation / NPD, renovation, proposition development and product launches.
* Experience within pet food, pet care, food, beverage or another premium FMCG category.
* Additional European languages are a plus.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

jobs.title: Research Engineer (Process)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Process & Chemical Engineer to lead the development, assessment, and scale-up of advanced treatment solutions for complex water, wastewater, and industrial effluents. The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).
* Publications: Minimum 3–5 publications in peer-reviewed journals; patents or book chapters preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional R&D teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Location**
Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

* Accountable for developing the EK centralised, nominated food and beverage suppliers to ensure that we are able to constantly improve our speed to market and efficiency gains.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:**

**Qualification:**

**Experience:**

* + 10+ years in culinary development, fine dining, hospitality R&D, or large-scale production. Airline catering experience preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist

**Location:**
United Arab Emirates (Remote)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:**
100% Remote — Work From Home

**Level:**
Senior

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist to provide remote technical analysis, formulation assessment, and product stability support for skincare and personal care products. The role focuses on evaluating interactions between cosmetic ingredients, assessing formulation compatibility, reviewing stability data, and identifying potential risks affecting product performance, appearance, texture, and shelf life.

The successful candidate will collaborate remotely with cosmetic chemists, formulation scientists, research and development teams, analytical laboratories, suppliers, and quality assurance professionals. This is a fully remote position; physical formulation preparation, laboratory testing, sample handling, stability experiments, and instrument operation must be performed by qualified local personnel.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and assess ingredient compatibility across skincare formulations, including creams, lotions, serums, gels, cleansers, sunscreens, and other topical products.
* Evaluate interactions between active ingredients, emulsifiers, surfactants, preservatives, stabilizers, antioxidants, fragrances, and functional additives.
* Analyze formulation data to identify potential incompatibilities involving pH, solubility, oxidation, precipitation, discoloration, and phase separation.
* Review stability study results covering temperature exposure, light sensitivity, freeze-thaw cycles, packaging interactions, and storage conditions.
* Assess ingredient specifications, supplier technical data sheets, certificates of analysis, and supporting safety documentation.
* Evaluate the compatibility of skincare ingredients with different formulation systems, including oil-in-water, water-in-oil, anhydrous, and gel-based systems.
* Review analytical reports relating to pH, viscosity, particle size, emulsion stability, preservative performance, and other relevant product characteristics.
* Support remote investigations into formulation instability, changes in product texture, ingredient degradation, and unexpected sensory variations.
* Assess the effects of formulation concentration, processing parameters, and ingredient substitution on product stability and performance.
* Review formulation development records, laboratory protocols, compatibility studies, and product quality documentation.
* Prepare technical reports, ingredient compatibility assessments, stability summaries, and evidence-based formulation recommendations.
* Collaborate remotely with product development, procurement, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing teams.
* Monitor developments in cosmetic ingredient science, formulation technology, and applicable cosmetic product requirements.
* Maintain accurate technical records and protect confidential formulations, supplier information, and product development data.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in skincare formulation, cosmetic ingredient compatibility, personal care product development, or formulation quality assurance.
* Strong understanding of cosmetic ingredients, their functional properties, and potential interactions within different formulation systems.
* Knowledge of emulsions, surfactants, preservatives, active ingredients, antioxidants, rheology modifiers, and formulation stabilization.
* Experience reviewing accelerated and real-time stability studies, compatibility assessments, and analytical laboratory reports.
* Familiarity with cosmetic testing methods, including pH measurement, viscosity analysis, emulsion stability assessment, and relevant chemical analysis techniques.
* Understanding of cosmetic product quality systems, ingredient specifications, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Ability to interpret technical data and translate findings into practical formulation improvement recommendations.
* Strong analytical, scientific writing, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, statistical analysis tools, digital laboratory systems, and remote collaboration platforms.
* High standards of scientific integrity, confidentiality, and evidence-based technical judgment.

What We Offer

* Fully remote, work-from-home employment arrangement.
* Full-time opportunity in a specialized skincare formulation and ingredient compatibility discipline.
* Competitive compensation based on qualifications and relevant experience.
* Opportunities to contribute to skincare innovation, formulation reliability, and product quality improvement.
* Professional collaboration with multidisciplinary cosmetic science, research, and product development teams.
* Ongoing learning and development in cosmetic chemistry, ingredient technology, and formulation science.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting relevant experience in skincare formulation, cosmetic ingredient compatibility, stability evaluation, and technical product development.

Please include examples of formulation projects, ingredient compatibility studies, stability investigations, or product improvement initiatives where applicable.

**Application Subject:**
Application – Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist (UAE Remote)

Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer.

* **Important Role Boundary:**
  This position is limited to remote technical analysis, formulation documentation review, laboratory data assessment, and virtual coordination. Physical ingredient handling, formulation preparation, laboratory experiments, chemical testing, stability trials, sample preparation, and instrument operation must be performed by qualified local laboratory personnel. Formal cosmetic safety assessments, clinical or dermatological judgments, regulated product claims, product compliance certifications, regulatory submissions, product release decisions, and statutory sign-offs must be completed by appropriately qualified and authorized professionals.

**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.

jobs.title: Quality & Hygiene Coordinator

Purpose of the Position

The Quality & Hygiene Coordinator is responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of quality assurance, food safety, hygiene, and compliance standards across all Food & Beverage operations in Dubai. The role ensures adherence to HACCP requirements, Dubai Municipality regulations, company policies, and operational standards through regular inspections, audits, training, and compliance monitoring.

The position plays a key role in promoting a culture of food safety excellence, operational consistency, and continuous improvement while ensuring the highest standards of hygiene and customer satisfaction are maintained.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Compliance

* Conduct routine quality and hygiene inspections across all operational areas.
* Monitor compliance with company SOPs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify non-conformities and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist in reviewing, updating, and implementing quality management procedures.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.

Food Safety & Hygiene

* Monitor food handling, preparation, storage, transportation, and service practices.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP standards, food safety regulations, and hygiene requirements.
* Conduct regular inspections of kitchens, storage facilities, service areas, and food outlets.
* Monitor cleaning schedules, sanitation procedures, and pest control programs.
* Verify temperature monitoring logs, food labeling, traceability records, and shelf-life controls.

Audits & Inspections

* Conduct internal audits and site compliance assessments.
* Assist departments in preparing for external audits and regulatory inspections.
* Track audit findings and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Maintain comprehensive audit records and supporting documentation.
* Prepare inspection reports and communicate findings to management.

Training & Awareness

* Support the delivery of food safety and hygiene training programs.
* Conduct toolbox talks and awareness sessions for operational teams.
* Promote safe food handling practices and personal hygiene standards.
* Monitor employee compliance with hygiene and safety requirements.
* Assist in developing training guides, SOPs, and educational materials.

Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of inspections, audits, incidents, and corrective actions.
* Update quality and food safety documentation as required.
* Ensure documentation is organized and readily available for audits and inspections.
* Prepare weekly and monthly compliance reports.
* Track non-conformities and monitor corrective action completion.

Incident & Risk Management

* Report food safety, hygiene, and quality concerns immediately.
* Assist in investigating customer complaints, food safety incidents, and operational issues.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action implementation.
* Maintain records of complaints, incidents, investigations, and outcomes.
* Escalate critical food safety risks to management without delay.

Supplier & Vendor Compliance

* Support supplier evaluations and compliance monitoring activities.
* Conduct supplier audits and documentation reviews when required.
* Verify receiving procedures and incoming product quality checks.

* Contribute to service improvement initiatives based on customer feedback.

Additional Responsibilities

* Participate in quality, food safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement projects.
* Support environmental health and workplace safety initiatives.
